title: Remote TAP Series Sales Setter (PST Hours)
description:
Remote TAP Sales Setter (PST Hours) 

The Remote TAP Sales Setter plays a crucial role in driving lead generation and appointment setting for TAP’s training programs. Working Pacific Time (PST) hours in a fully remote capacity, you will focus on connecting with instructors affiliated with the American Culinary Association who prepare students for the Food Safety Manager Certification. Through proactive outreach, including direct messaging on social platforms and cold calling via OpenPhone, you will introduce these instructors to TAP’s solutions and schedule product demo meetings with our Learning Managers. The ideal candidate is a self- motivated communicator who can ask insightful questions about instructors’ current training outcomes (e.g., “What is your passing rate?” or “How much time do you spend teaching the Food Safety Manager Certification?”) and highlight how TAP’s training prepares learners to pass on the first attempt. This role is key to expanding TAP’s impact by ensuring prospective clients understand our value and are eager to learn more in a scheduled demo. 



What you'll do:

Key Responsibilities



· Lead Generation & Outreach: Identify and prospect American Culinary Association instructors via social media channels (Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn). Initiate direct message conversations and conduct cold calls using contact data provided through OpenPhone to introduce TAP’s training offerings and gauge interest.



· Qualifying Prospects: Engage in consultative conversations by asking targeted questions about the instructor’s current program, such as student passing rates and the time invested in teaching the Food Safety Manager Certification.



· Value Proposition Communication: Clearly articulate TAP’s benefits, emphasizing that our courses help learners pass certification exams on their first attempt.



· Appointment Setting: Schedule and coordinate demo appointments between interested instructor prospects and TAP’s Learning Managers, adhering to PST availability. Confirm appointments with prospects.



· CRM Tracking: Diligently document all interactions, notes, and appointment details in Salesforce. Maintain an organized pipeline of leads.



· Collaboration: Work closely with Learning Managers and the sales team to smoothly transition qualified leads. Share relevant prospect insights gathered during outreach.



· Performance & Follow-up: Meet or exceed weekly and monthly targets for outreach and booked appointments. Follow up post-demo as needed.





 

What we're looking for:

Qualifications

· Experience: Previous sales development, appointment setting, or lead generation experience (remote preferred). Experience with cold outreach and social media prospecting strongly preferred.



· Social Media & Cold Calling Skills: Proficiency with Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, and comfort conducting cold calls through OpenPhone.



· Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication. Strong active listening skills ssential.



· Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with culinary education or certification training advantageous.



· CRM Proficiency: Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools for lead tracking.



· Self-Motivated & Results-Driven: Ability to independently manage time and meet appointment targets.



· Interpersonal Skills: Positive, resilient, and adaptable.



· Availability: Must work Pacific Time hours. Reliable internet and remote workspace required.



Would be a plus:

Compensation Details



This role offers performance-based compensation, with $25 paid for each appointment set that converts into a paying customer. This incentivizes effective appointment setting and rewards results.

title: Technical Recruiter (Remote)
description:
Role Overview



Barrister is seeking a motivated and proactive Technical Recruiter to join our

Technician Management & Deployment (TMD) division.

This is a high-volume, outbound recruiting role focused on identifying, screening, and

onboarding qualified field service technicians to support Barrister's nationwide service

requirements and Service Level Agreements (SLAs).

Success requires someone who is comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls,

engaging prospective technicians, evaluating technical qualifications, and consistently

moving candidates through the recruiting and onboarding pipeline.



Key Responsibilities



High-Volume Talent Acquisition:

Actively source and recruit qualified field service technicians using job boards, resume

databases, professional networks, referrals, internal resources, and cold outreach.



Candidate Screening:

Conduct telephone interviews to evaluate technical experience, field service

background, communication skills, tools, transportation, availability, geographic

coverage, and overall suitability for available opportunities.



Technical Assessment:

Identify technicians with experience in areas such as desktop and laptop support,

printers, point-of-sale equipment, networking, servers, hardware installation, equipment

replacement, break-fix service, and other IT field services.



Full-Cycle Recruitment:

Move qualified candidates through Barrister's recruiting and onboarding process,

including candidate qualification, testing or skills evaluation, required documentation,

background screening coordination, training, and orientation.



Deployment Support:

Work closely with internal Operations and Technician Assignment teams to understand

technician coverage gaps, open staffing requirements, client needs, and SLA priorities.



Pipeline Management:

Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting activity within Barrister's recruitment

and tracking systems. Follow up consistently with candidates until they complete

onboarding or are removed from consideration.



Performance Accountability:

Meet established recruiting and productivity expectations, which may include outbound

call volume, talk time, candidate activity, technician identification, completed

onboarding, and assigned staffing objectives.



Qualifications



- Experience in high-volume recruiting, staffing, tele-sales, call center operations,

or outbound customer engagement.

- Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.

- Comfortable working in a high-volume Outbound calling environment.

- Strong telephone interviewing and candidate-engagement skills.

- Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment.

- Strong organizational and follow-up skills.

- Ability to manage multiple candidates, staffing requests, and priorities

simultaneously.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, metrics-driven and SLA-focused

environment.

- Strong computer skills and ability to work with web-based recruiting and tracking

systems.

- Previous IT staffing, technical recruiting, or field service recruiting experience is

strongly preferred.



Terms of Employment



Schedule: Full-Time, 40 hours per week. Work schedule will support Barrister's U.S.-

based operations.



Remote Work: This is a 100% remote position. Candidates must have a reliable

computer, stable high-speed internet connection, headset/telephone capability, and a

professional remote work environment.

title: Security Compliance Program Lead
description:
About the Engagement



We're pursuing SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certification concurrently, on a fixed schedule, and need someone to take the program from kickoff to a clean report/certificate — then hand off a running program to an internal owner.



Two dates anchor the engagement and do not move: the ISO 27001 certificate in March 2027 and the SOC 2 Type II report in May 2027. There's no slack before January, so month one is spent locking auditor commitments, not writing documents.



This is a hands-on individual contributor role, not a supervisory one. You'll write the policies, chase the evidence, and sit in the audit meetings yourself — working across engineering, IT, HR, legal, and field operations, none of whom report to you. The work runs on influence and follow-through, not authority.



Key Deliverables

-ISMS scope statement and SOC 2 system description — Due Nov 2026 / Jan 2027

-Risk assessment (ISO 27001 clause 6.1) + risk treatment plan — Due Dec 2026

-Approved policy set (~20 policies, Annex A structure) — Due Nov 2026

-Statement of Applicability, all 93 Annex A controls — Due Dec 2026

-Compliance platform configured and collecting evidence — Due Nov 2026

-Remediation complete and evidenced across all teams — Due Dec 2026

-Vendor risk register, third-party reports, signed DPAs — Due Dec 2026

-Penetration test commissioned; critical findings closed — Due Dec 2026

-ISMS internal audit and management review documented — Due Dec 2026

-SOC 2 Type I report issued — Due Jan 2027

-ISO 27001 certificate issued — Due Mar 2027

-SOC 2 Type II report issued, no material exceptions — Due May 2027

-Handover pack + trained internal owner — Due Jun 2027



What You'll Do

-Own the program plan, schedule, and budget; report progress to leadership monthly

-Contract and manage the CPA firm and certification body — scheduling, evidence requests, walkthroughs, findings/responses

-Define and document one scope boundary serving both frameworks

-Write the policies, Statement of Applicability, and system description

-Drive cross-team remediation (access control, logging, encryption, change management, onboarding/offboarding), holding owners to dates and escalating early

-Administer the compliance automation platform and keep evidence collection running

-Run vendor risk reviews; collect third-party reports and DPAs

-Coordinate the penetration test, internal audit, and management review

-Document the running program and train the internal owner who takes it on



Requirements



Required

-Has personally taken a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 engagement through to a clean report/certificate — as the owner, not a contributor

-3+ years in security compliance, GRC, IT audit, or closely related field

-Working knowledge of core security controls: IAM, MFA, logging & monitoring, encryption, endpoint management, change management

-Clear, plain writing — policies, system description, and audit responses are most of the output

-Able to hold people to commitments without line authority

-Available to start in October 2026, with a fixed end date



Preferred

-Has run both frameworks together, or mapped one control set across two

-Hands-on with a compliance automation platform (Vanta, Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto, or similar)

-Background in IT services, managed services, or field services (environments with subcontractors/technician access to customer systems)

-CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor certification



Terms

-Structure: Open to independent contractor or fixed-term employment, whichever the candidate prefers

-Commitment: Full time; October 2026–February 2027 is the heaviest build sprint, pace eases once audits are underway

-Completion: Engagement ends when the Type II report is issued and handover is complete; an extension into the ongoing program may be offered but is not guaranteed to either party

-Milestone structure (contractors): A portion of fee may be tied to deliverables #10, #11, and #12 — terms to be agreed



How to Apply



Please submit:

-A summary of a SOC 2 or ISO 27001 engagement you personally owned end-to-end, and the outcome

-Relevant certifications (CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor), if any

-Your availability for an October 2026 start

title: Property Maintenance & Field Operations Supervisor / Manager
description:
Barrister Premier Properties, LLC

Mandeville / Covington — Northshore Louisiana



Barrister Premier Properties, LLC is seeking an experienced, hands-on Property Maintenance & Field Operations Supervisor / Manager to take ownership of maintenance and field operations across our portfolio of multifamily apartments, hotels, shopping centers, commercial properties, and tenant spaces throughout the Northshore.



We are looking for someone with strong construction and property maintenance experience who can diagnose problems, determine the correct repair solution, lead a 3–4 person in-house maintenance crew, manage work orders, procure materials, and personally perform or assist with repairs when needed.



Key Responsibilities



-Manage, assign, prioritize, and track daily maintenance work orders.

-Lead, supervise, and hold accountable a 3–4 person in-house maintenance crew.

-Diagnose building, construction, and maintenance issues and determine the appropriate repair solution.

-Create scopes of work, material lists, and basic material takeoffs.

-Purchase and stage materials ahead of scheduled work and respond quickly to emergency material needs.

-Perform hands-on repairs and maintenance alongside the crew when necessary.

-Conduct regular property walks and inspections to identify maintenance needs before they become larger problems.

-Perform tenant and resident move-out inspections and coordinate turnover work.

-Establish and maintain preventative maintenance schedules across the portfolio.

-Respond to emergency maintenance issues and prioritize work based on urgency, safety, property damage exposure, and operational impact.

-Track outstanding repairs and ensure work is completed properly, timely, and to company standards.

-Coordinate with outside subcontractors when work requires specialized trades or additional manpower.

-Verify completed work and maintain accountability for quality, materials, labor, and company resources.

-Take full ownership of maintenance issues from initial diagnosis through final completion.



Qualifications



-5+ years of experience in construction, property maintenance, facilities maintenance, or maintenance supervision.

-Strong working knowledge of multiple trades, including:

            -Carpentry and general construction

            -Plumbing

            -Electrical

            -HVAC

            -Drywall

            -Painting and finishes

-Proven ability to lead and manage maintenance or construction personnel.

-Experience preparing scopes of work, material takeoffs, and purchasing materials.

-Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving ability.

-Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple active work orders and properties simultaneously.

-Comfortable working in the field daily and performing hands-on work when required.

-Reliable transportation and a clean driving record.

-Strong communication skills and professional presence when interacting with tenants, residents, vendors, subcontractors, and company personnel.



Ideal Candidate



-We are looking for someone who is hands-on, dependable, organized, decisive, and accountable.

-The right candidate should be able to walk into a property, identify the problem, determine the appropriate solution, obtain the necessary materials, assign or perform the work, and make sure the job is completed correctly.

-You should be comfortable making decisions in the field, working under pressure, managing competing priorities, leading a crew, and treating company properties, materials, equipment, and resources as if they were your own.

-We want someone who does not simply identify problems or pass them along. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the problem and drives it through completion.

-This position is critical to establishing and maintaining a reliable, organized, responsive, and accountable in-house property maintenance operation across the Barrister Premier Properties portfolio.

title: Account Manager
description:
Position Summary



The Account Manager is the primary relationship owner for an assigned portfolio of clients. This role protects and grows recurring revenue by understanding each client’s business objectives, ensuring dependable service delivery, resolving issues with urgency, and identifying practical opportunities to expand Barrister’s value. The Account Manager serves as a trusted advisor and internal quarterback, aligning sales, operations, service delivery, finance, and subject-matter experts around measurable client outcomes.



Essential Responsibilities



Client Relationship Ownership & Retention

-Own day-to-day and strategic relationships for assigned accounts, serving as a responsive, dependable point of contact for client stakeholders.

-Build and maintain multi-level relationships with executive sponsors, decision makers, procurement, IT/operations leaders, and end users; create and maintain current relationship maps.

-Develop a thorough understanding of each client’s business model, priorities, operating environment, contractual commitments, and definition of success.

-Conduct regular account touchpoints and formal Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to review performance, risks, business priorities, realized value, and upcoming opportunities.

-Measure and improve client health, satisfaction, retention, and advocacy; actively gather feedback and turn it into clear actions and follow-up communication.

-Anticipate concerns, identify churn or service risks early, and lead timely recovery plans through resolution and client confirmation.



Account Strategy, Revenue Growth & Commercial Management

-Create, maintain, and execute an account business plan for each assigned client, including revenue and margin goals, renewal milestones, growth targets, relationship strategy, risk mitigation, and action owners.

-Identify whitespace and customer needs that can be addressed through appropriate services, solutions, upgrades, renewals, cross-sell, or upsell opportunities.

-Lead consultative discovery and value-based conversations; translate client requirements into practical recommendations, proposals, and measurable business cases.

-Partner with Sales Executives and technical or operational teams to qualify opportunities, develop solutions, prepare pricing and proposals, negotiate within authority, and close business.

-Protect profitability by considering scope, delivery feasibility, service levels, costs, pricing, and contract commitments before making or presenting commitments.

-Drive contract renewal planning well in advance of expiration, including commercial strategy, client alignment, required approvals, and complete CRM documentation.



Service Delivery, Escalation & Internal Leadership

-Coordinate cross-functional resources to ensure products and services are delivered on time, within scope and budget, and in accordance with service-level agreements (SLAs).

-Act as the client advocate internally while balancing client needs with company commitments, operational realities, compliance obligations, and financial goals.

-Lead escalations from initial triage through documented corrective action, regular status communication, root-cause review when appropriate, and confirmed closure.

-Monitor service performance, deliverables, invoicing, scheduling, and key dependencies; promptly escalate material delivery, cost, quality, or compliance risks.

-Participate in client kickoffs, implementation transitions, and service reviews to establish clear expectations, ownership, communication cadence, and success measures.

-Develop and communicate account-level project plans for material client initiatives, clearly defining milestones, owners, dependencies, risks, and completion criteria.

-Standardize and refine delivery processes across the portfolio so strategic clients receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

-Support continuous improvement by identifying recurring issues, process gaps, training needs, and scalable improvements across accounts.



Financial, Data & Pipeline Discipline

-Manage to assigned revenue, retention, margin, renewal, expansion, and customer-experience targets.

-Maintain accurate, timely CRM records for contacts, opportunities, account plans, activities, renewal dates, forecasts, risks, and next steps.

-Review account health and financial performance, including volume trends, utilization, margin, expenses, invoicing, and SLA compliance; flag variances and potential overruns immediately.

-Provide clear weekly, monthly, and quarterly reporting and forecasts, including pipeline, renewal outlook, wins, risks, recovery actions, and required leadership support.

-Use client data, industry insight, and internal performance information to prioritize initiatives, substantiate recommendations, and quantify value or return on investment.



Client Enablement & Business Improvement

-Provide or coordinate client-specific education, enablement, and supporting materials that improve adoption, service outcomes, and growth of the company’s offerings.

-Identify and implement service-delivery and account-management improvements that reduce avoidable cost, improve efficiency, and protect the client experience.

-Use formal customer evaluations and feedback channels to validate satisfaction, recognize performance gaps, and drive continuous improvement.

-Maintain appropriate confidentiality and discretion when handling client, commercial, operational, or financial information.



Qualifications



Required

-Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience.

-3+ years of client-facing account management, customer success, sales, service management, project management, or related experience; experience managing complex B2B accounts preferred.

-Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships, retain business, solve problems, and manage several priorities with sound judgment.

-Strong written, verbal, presentation, organizational, analytical, and interpersonal communication skills.

-Ability to work effectively across a matrixed organization and influence internal and external stakeholders at multiple levels.

-Proficiency with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and Microsoft Office, including Excel and PowerPoint.



Preferred

-Experience meeting revenue, renewal, growth, margin, or customer-satisfaction goals within a technology, managed services, IT lifecycle, telecommunications, logistics, or other complex service environment.

-Experience delivering QBRs, account business plans, complex proposals, renewals, and contract negotiations.

-Experience coordinating service delivery, technical, logistics, finance, or operational teams for complex client programs.

-Working knowledge of the company’s relevant solutions, delivery model, competitive landscape, and client industry.



Core Competencies



-Client-centered and consultative: listens carefully, earns credibility, connects solutions to business outcomes, and communicates honestly.

-Commercially accountable: balances client value with revenue, margin, scope, and long-term account health.

-Proactive and organized: anticipates needs, follows through, manages deadlines, and maintains complete documentation.

-Analytical and solutions-oriented: uses data to recognize patterns, diagnose issues, prioritize actions, and improve results.

-Collaborative and resilient: coordinates diverse teams, handles difficult conversations professionally, and remains calm under pressure.

-Ethical and dependable: protects confidential information, honors commitments, follows policies, and exercises sound judgment.



Performance Measures



-Specific targets will be established by leadership based on portfolio type, account maturity, and company priorities. Typical measures include:

-Revenue retention, renewal rate, expansion revenue, quota attainment, and year-over-year growth.

-Portfolio margin, pricing discipline, forecast accuracy, invoice timeliness, and control of avoidable costs or overruns.

-Client satisfaction, Net Promoter Score (NPS) or equivalent feedback, churn, issue-response time, and escalation resolution.

-SLA performance, implementation/service quality, account-plan completion, QBR completion, CRM data quality, and pipeline coverage.

-Quality of executive relationships, client engagement, teamwork, and demonstrated contribution to scalable process improvements.



Work Environment & Additional Information



This position may require occasional travel to client locations, industry events, or internal meetings, depending on portfolio needs. The duties and responsibilities above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and are not an exhaustive list. Management may assign additional duties consistent with the role and business needs.



Equipment and System Requirements



This is a remote role. You must provide your own computer and setup that meet these minimum specifications before onboarding:



-Operating system: Windows 11 Pro only, genuine and fully updated

-Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5 (or equivalent)

-Memory (RAM): at least 16GB

-Storage: at least 256GB SSD (solid-state drive)

-Internet: dedicated connection with at least 100 Mbps download, 20 Mbps upload, and under 80 ms ping

-Peripherals: noise-canceling USB headset and HD webcam

-Backup power: uninterruptible power supply (UPS) or another backup power solution



Not accepted: Apple/Mac computers, Chromebooks, Linux, any operating system other than Windows 11 Pro, and hard disk drives (HDD).



During screening, you’ll be asked to submit a screenshot of your computer’s specifications and a speed test result. Candidates whose equipment doesn’t meet these requirements can’t be onboarded.

title: Senior Restaurant Bookkeeper – Experienced Candidates Only
description:
We are seeking a seasoned bookkeeper with extensive restaurant industry experience to support our client engagements on a contract basis. **This is not an entry-level position. Applicants without prior restaurant bookkeeping experience will not be considered.**



The right candidate is a self-manager who brings the knowledge, skill set, and organization required to complete the work independently, accurately, and on time across multiple clients.



**What You'll Do**



Manage full-cycle bookkeeping across multiple restaurant clients, including:



- Maintaining and refining restaurant-specific charts of accounts (COGS by category, tip liabilities, gift card liability, comps and voids, etc.)

- Recording and reconciling daily sales from POS systems, including breakdowns by revenue center, payment type, tax, tips, and discounts

- Reconciling POS deposits to bank activity and identifying discrepancies

- Booking payroll journal entries and payroll accruals, including tipped wages, tip credits, and period-end accruals across pay cycles

- Managing inventory entries, period-end inventory adjustments, and investigating food and beverage cost variance against theoretical cost using restaurant inventory platforms such as Restaurant365 (R365) and MarginEdge

- Reconciling bank, credit card, and merchant processor accounts

- Producing accurate, timely monthly financials with meaningful variance commentary



**Required Experience**



- Extensive bookkeeping experience specifically in the restaurant industry

- Proven experience managing the books for multiple restaurant clients simultaneously, with the organization and time management skills to keep each client's work on track

- Working knowledge of at least one major restaurant POS system (Toast, Square for Restaurants, etc.) and how its data flows into the books

- Hands-on experience with restaurant inventory and back-office platforms such as Restaurant365 (R365), MarginEdge, or comparable systems

- Proficiency in QuickBooks Online

- Confident handling of payroll accruals, tip reporting, and the journal entries that come with them

- Demonstrated ability to investigate and explain inventory variance

- Strong reconciliation discipline and attention to detail

- Ability to work independently, meet client deadlines, and communicate clearly with clients



**Engagement Details**



- Part time contractor role

- The role will begin with 4 active clients at approximately 20 hours per week, with potential to grow as the book of business expands

- Starting rate: $12/hour, with the opportunity to increase quickly for a candidate who demonstrates reliability and skill

- **Availability requirement:** Must be available to meet synchronously at least twice per week (approx 1 hour each meeting) during Eastern Time business hours (9:00 AM to 5:00 PM EST). Remaining hours can be worked independently on an agreed-upon schedule of your choosing, provided client deadlines are met.



**To Apply**



Please submit a brief summary of your restaurant bookkeeping experience, including the POS and inventory systems you've worked with, the approximate size and type of restaurant operations you've supported, and your experience handling multiple concurrent clients.

title: Hiring: Advanced Video Editor — Long-Form YouTube Essays, Reels, Podcasts
description:
About the role



We run a YouTube channel, two instagram pages, and a membership community. We're looking for an editor with real video editing and animation skills, plus the ability to own content editing from raw footage -> long form polished edit -> short form edits and repurposing content as needed.



This is an ongoing, recurring role (per-video or weekly, negotiable) covering the full pipeline: long-form YouTube essays (30–40 min), podcast uploads (just the audio file from the long form content videos), thumbnails, and short-form Reels cut from the long-form material.



Technical requirements



- Dynamic masking & layering: Rotoscope/masking the subject(s) to composite them in front things onscreen

- Comfortable with keyframed mask tracking across moving subjects, not just static crops.

- Pattern interruptions / cutting rhythm: Break up static talking-head footage every few seconds using punch-in zooms, meme splices, and GIF cutaways — timed to beats in the VO, not randomly dropped in.

- Understand pacing well enough to combat attention drop-off across a 30–40 minute runtime without making the edit feel frantic of overdone

- Textual overlays / kinetic typography: Syncing quote cards, text, research citations, etc. over the footage according the the VO

- J-cuts & L-cuts

- color grading

- 2d onscreen stop motion animation

- Multimedia intercutting: intercut archival footage, stock clips, screen recordings, still images, and audio clips within a single sequence — multi-track compositing, not just A/B-roll switching.

- Basic video editing skills, of course





Plus Additional pipeline responsibilities:



- Long-form YouTube editing (using the skills above)

- Short form content editing (reels; using the skills above)

- Repurposing long form content into short form reels

- Content sourcing: Source appropriate footage, imagery, film clips, and reference material (YouTube, Pinterest, archive sites, etc.) that the masking and intercutting techniques above depend on.

- Creating YouTube thumbnails

- Creating Reel covers

- Exporting mp3 files of long form content



Tools/Skills

- A real NLE with compositing capability — Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, or After Effects (masking/roto and multi-track work isn't feasible in a transcript-based editor alone; Descript may be used for the initial assembly/transcript-based cut, but final compositing needs a proper timeline tool).

- A thumbnail/graphics tool (Photoshop, Canva, etc.)

- Comfortable sourcing and downloading reference footage/images from YouTube, Pinterest, and archival sources.

- Familiarity with uploading/publishing to YouTube and a podcast host.

- Excellent English proficiency



What I'm looking for in you

- Real command of masking/keying, keyframed text, split edits, and multi-track compositing — not template-based or AI-slop-auto-edit work.

- Can own the full pipeline: raw footage ? composited long-form edit ? thumbnail ? published YouTube video ? podcast upload ? repurposed Reels.

- Strong pacing instincts for long-form (30–40 min) content — know how to keep attention without making the edit feel chaotic.

- Comfortable doing your own research/sourcing for the footage and imagery your composites depend on.

- Precise with instructions like "cut whole sentences only"

- Unique and creative artistic taste and eye. We are not looking for content that looks like everyone else's.



To apply:

Send a reel or examples showing masking/compositing work (subject placed into archival footage or scenes), J-cut/L-cut usage in a long-form piece, and text/citation overlay work.



please note: generic "talking head" video edits or AI content submissions will not be considered.

title: Midterm Rental Manager
description:
About West Coast Homestays

West Coast Homestays is a short-term rental management company operating roughly 80 furnished properties, primarily in San Diego, California. Alongside our nightly stays, a growing share of our portfolio is leased on mid-term stays of 30+ days, including seasonal units that switch between short-term and mid-term depending on the time of year. We're a lean, operations-focused team that cares about guest experience, owner returns, and doing things right the first time.



The Role

We're hiring a Mid-Term Rental (MTR) Agent to fully own our mid-term rental program from first inquiry to final rent payment. You'll be the single point of accountability for every MTR unit in the portfolio, year-round and seasonal: keeping listings live and accurate, turning leads into signed leases, building relationships with housing partners, and making sure rent is collected on time.



This is a high-ownership role for someone who is organized, persistent with follow-ups, comfortable negotiating, and excited to grow occupancy and revenue on a portfolio that's scaling.



What You'll Own:

-Listings & Inventory

-Create, maintain, and optimize MTR listings across mid-term channels (e.g., Furnished Finder, Airbnb monthly stays, Zillow/rental sites, corporate housing networks)

-Keep photos, descriptions, amenities, availability, and pricing accurate and consistent across every channel

-Manage the calendar for seasonal properties, coordinating with the STR team on when units move between short-term and mid-term use

-Flag listing gaps or upcoming vacancies early so units aren't sitting empty



Leads & Follow-Up

-Respond quickly to all inbound MTR inquiries via
, platform messaging, phone, and text

-Qualify leads (dates, budget, occupants, pets, purpose of stay) and match them to the right unit

-Run a disciplined follow-up cadence so no lead goes cold

-Track every lead and its status in our CRM/pipeline from first contact to close



Tours & Showings

-Schedule and coordinate tours, both virtual (video walkthroughs) and in-person through local team members

-Confirm tour times with prospects and on-the-ground staff, and send reminders

-Follow up promptly after every tour to move prospects toward a signed lease



Pricing & Negotiation

-Set and update MTR rates based on seasonality, demand, comparable listings, and occupancy targets

-Negotiate rates, lease terms, and move-in dates with tenants and partners within approved guidelines

-Recommend pricing changes to leadership with supporting data



Housing Partner Relationships

-Proactively build and maintain relationships with housing partners: insurance/ALE (additional living expense) housing providers and adjusters, travel nurse and medical staffing agencies, corporate relocation firms, military housing contacts, and similar sources of mid-term demand

-Respond to partner placement requests quickly with available inventory and quotes

-Grow a repeat-placement pipeline so partners come to us first



Leases & Move-In

-Prepare, send, and get leases and rental agreements signed electronically

-Collect required documents, deposits, and screening/verification items before move-in

-Coordinate move-in and move-out logistics with cleaning, maintenance, and guest-experience teams

-Handle lease extensions, early terminations, and renewals



Rent Collection & Tracking

-Track rent payments, deposits, and partner invoices for every active MTR

-Send payment reminders and follow up on late or missed payments

-Maintain accurate records and reconcile payments with our finance/bookkeeping team

-Escalate collection issues to leadership when needed



Reporting

-Keep a live view of MTR occupancy, pipeline, upcoming vacancies, and rent status

-Share a weekly update with leadership on leads, conversions, revenue, and issues



How Success Is Measured

-MTR occupancy rate and vacant days between stays

-Lead response time and lead-to-lease conversion rate

-Average monthly rate achieved vs. target

-On-time rent collection rate

-Number of active housing partners and repeat placements



What We're Looking For:

-2+ years of experience in property management, leasing, mid-term or corporate housing, short-term rentals, or a similar sales/leasing role

-Excellent written and spoken English; confident communicating with U.S. tenants, partners, and adjusters by phone,
, and text

-Proven track record of lead management and persistent, professional follow-up

-Comfortable negotiating rates and terms

-Highly organized, with strong attention to detail across many units and deadlines at once

-Experience with CRMs, property management software, and e-signature tools

-Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet work setup, and a working phone line



Nice to Have

-Direct experience working with insurance housing / ALE providers or travel nurse housing

-Experience with Furnished Finder, Airbnb, Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, or similar platforms

-Familiarity with U.S. residential leasing practices (California experience a plus)

-Basic revenue management or dynamic pricing experience



Schedule & Location

-Full-time, fully remote, offshore position

-Must work a schedule with substantial overlap with U.S. Pacific Time (San Diego) business hours to handle leads, tours, and partner calls in real time



Compensation

Pay is competitive and based on experience (DOE).

description:
Experienced appointment setters only. You need at least 2 years setting appointments in solar or water damage restoration, with appointments you booked that actually took place. If you don’t have this, please don’t apply. Applications that don’t follow the steps below won’t be reviewed.



About us

StepCare is a 24/7 water damage and biohazard restoration company in Toronto, Canada. Most of our jobs are paid by insurance, so property managers and trades who refer us are our best source of work.



The job



You call property managers, retirement homes, commercial buildings, plumbers and HVAC companies in the Greater Toronto Area. You introduce StepCare and earn a next step: permission to send our portfolio, or a meeting with our operations team, so they call us first when one of their properties has water damage.



We give you the call list: named decision-makers with direct numbers.

You log every call and next step in our CRM (GoHighLevel).

You also answer or call back inbound emergency leads quickly, and qualify them using our playbook.



Why solar or restoration?



Solar setters: booking a solar site visit and booking a restoration meeting are the same skill. You reach the property owner or decision-maker, handle “we already have someone” or “not now”, and lock a time. We’ll train you on restoration.

Restoration setters: you already know water damage, insurance claims and property managers. You’ll be productive from week one.



Schedule

Full-time or part-time, during Toronto business hours (night shift in PH). Tell us which one you want.



Must have



2+ years of appointment setting in solar (site visits or consultations) or water damage restoration (property managers, homeowners or insurance)

Excellent spoken English, easy to understand

Comfortable with a CRM, and logging every call

Quiet workspace and stable internet

Takes feedback well and changes quickly



Big plus



Other B2B cold calling with decision-makers

Roofing or storm damage

Insurance or property claims (BPO counts)

Xactimate



Pay



Full-time: US$[600–900]/month plus monthly commission for meetings that take place.

Part-time: prorated.

Paid 4-week trial.



How to apply (all 4 steps, or we won’t review your application)



Subject line: “GTA Partner Call – [X] years – [Solar or Restoration] – FT/PT”

Your experience, in 3 lines: companies or industries you’ve set appointments for, years in each, and your average appointments that took place per week.

 her our portfolio.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
Revenue Manager



About Us

We are a revenue management consultancy for short-term and vacation rental operators. We help property managers and owners grow revenue through data-driven pricing, sharp market strategy, and hands-on account management. Our clients trust us to run pricing on their portfolios day to day and to give them a clear picture of performance and opportunity.



The Role

We're hiring an experienced Revenue Manager to own a book of client accounts end to end. You'll set and execute pricing strategy in PriceLabs, analyze performance, build and present reports, and serve as the primary point of contact for your clients. This is a highly skilled role: we're looking for someone who already knows how to move RevPAR, can explain the "why" behind every pricing decision, and is confident leading client conversations.



What You'll Own



Pricing Strategy & Execution

• Own client accounts in PriceLabs: setup, onboarding, base/min/max prices, customizations, seasonal profiles, occupancy-based adjustments, orphan-day and last-minute rules, and minimum-stay settings

• Set the overall revenue strategy for each client portfolio based on market data, booking pace, seasonality, events, and client goals

• Make ongoing pricing updates and adjustments to respond to pace, pickup, and market shifts

• Monitor booking windows, length of stay, occupancy, ADR, and RevPAR, and act quickly on underperformance

• Identify and price around demand drivers such as holidays, events, conferences, and school calendars



Market & Performance Analysis

• Run competitive set and market analyses using PriceLabs Market Dashboards, AirDNA, Key Data, or similar tools

• Track pacing against last year and against the market, and diagnose the root cause of gaps

• Recommend non-pricing revenue levers to clients: listing optimization, channel mix, minimum-stay strategy, amenities, and positioning



Reporting

• Build and maintain recurring client performance reports (weekly/monthly) covering occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, pace, and forecast

• Translate data into clear insights and next steps that clients can act on

• Keep internal dashboards and account notes up to date



Client Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for your client accounts

• Lead regular strategy calls and performance reviews with clients

• Onboard new clients: gather goals, audit current pricing and listings, and implement an initial strategy

• Set expectations, handle questions and pushback professionally, and build long-term trust

• Identify opportunities to expand services and retain clients



Team & Process

• Contribute to internal playbooks, pricing standards, and best practices

• Share market insights with the team and help raise the bar across the consultancy



How Success Is Measured

• Revenue and RevPAR growth for client portfolios, year over year and vs. market

• Occupancy and ADR performance against targets and comp sets

• Client retention and satisfaction

• Timeliness and quality of reports and pricing updates



What We're Looking For

Required

• 4+ years of revenue management experience, ideally in short-term or vacation rentals (hotel RM experience also considered)

• Proven track record of increasing revenue performance, with examples and results you can walk us through

• Advanced, hands-on experience with PriceLabs

• Strong command of RM metrics and concepts: ADR, occupancy, RevPAR, pace, pickup, booking window, LOS, and forecasting

• Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel / Google Sheets

• Excellent written and spoken English; confident leading client meetings and presenting results

• Highly organized and able to manage multiple client portfolios at once

• Reliable high-speed internet and a professional, quiet work setup



Nice to Have

• Experience with other pricing tools (Wheelhouse, Beyond, DPGO) and market data tools (AirDNA, Key Data, Transparent)

• Experience with PMS platforms such as Guesty, Hostaway, OwnerRez, or Track

• Experience in a client-facing consultancy or agency role

• Knowledge of multiple U.S. vacation rental markets



Schedule & Location

• Full-time, fully remote, offshore position

• Must work a schedule with substantial overlap with U.S. business hours for client meetings and time-sensitive pricing updates



Compensation

Pay is competitive and based on experience (DOE).

title: Commercial Funding Operations Coordinator
description:
At Teal Bay Capital, we help move commercial lending and capital-raise opportunities from intake through closing. You’ll support the back-office funding work and coordinate with borrowers, brokers, lenders, and family-office contacts.



What you’ll do

• Enter new opportunities in Zoho CRM and keep each deal’s stage, owner, next action, and due date current.

• Request and collect borrower documents for commercial real estate loans, including financial statements, bank statements, tax returns, entity and ownership records, debt schedules, collateral documents, and property records as applicable.

• Review financial statements and other documents for completeness and consistency, and flag discrepancies for review.

• Track outstanding items and borrower responses, and escalate delays in document collection.

• Build underwriting and due diligence packages with a deal summary, document index, financial schedules, and a list of open items.

• Coordinate submissions, outstanding conditions, and closing documentation, and organize loan files.

• Use approved channels to collect, store, and share confidential records.

• Maintain broker and family-office contact records, prepare meeting briefs, coordinate introductions, and follow up on commitments.



What we need

We need an experienced candidate who has supported commercial lending or other business-purpose funding. Experience supporting capital raises or working with family offices is a plus. You should understand how a deal moves from intake and diligence through submission, closing, and funding, and have hands-on experience managing contacts, deals, tasks, and pipeline updates in Zoho CRM.



You’ll communicate clearly and professionally in spoken and written English when following up with borrowers and brokers, explaining document requirements, and discussing missing items. You’ll use Microsoft Word and Microsoft Excel to prepare submission summaries, checklists, trackers, and financial schedules. Adobe Acrobat can also be useful in this work.



We value clear communication, ownership, and steady follow-through. Funding priorities can shift quickly, so we rely on you to keep Zoho CRM current, flag delays early, and make sure every active deal has a clear next step. You’ll handle sensitive borrower information and use sound judgment when doing so.



Careful, consistent, and dependable. You follow a clear process, notice discrepancies, and stay patient and persistent when collecting outstanding documents.



This role calls for judgment and ownership beyond basic data entry. Good work means complete, well-organized underwriting packages, with financial statements and applicable property and entity records checked for completeness and consistency.



The role starts in back-office funding operations and can grow into direct client communication, broker account support, and capital partner relationship coordination. A performance bonus is offered.



Hours

We work 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. US Central time, 40 hours a week. This is a night shift in the Philippines, typically 11 p.m. to 7 a.m. Philippine time.



We expect this role to start in the coming weeks. This is an independent contractor role. We review every application and invite the best fits to an interview.



Pay: $800.00 per month



To apply, please include the following:

• Write a brief email asking a broker for the borrower’s latest P&L and signed operating agreement by Friday.



Please answer these questions:

What commercial funding deal did you support, and what documents did you review for submission?

How have you used Zoho CRM, Word, and Excel to manage funding deals?

Have you worked with family offices?

title: Part-Time QA Tester (Web + iPhone + Android) for Home Staging Software. Record Your Sessions
description:
StageEngine is software that runs home staging companies: their furniture inventory, jobs, proposals, contracts, invoices and payments. We're a small US company in California. We need a careful manual tester who enjoys trying to break things, every week, on a real iPhone, a real Android phone and a computer.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Every week we put a new version of the app on our test site. Within 48 hours, work through that week's checklist (usually 30-80 checks) and mark each one pass, fail or blocked.

- Then use the app the way a staging company's office manager would (quote a job, send a contract, bill a client, check furniture in and out) and find where it breaks or where a real user would get stuck.

- Write clear bug reports: the steps, what you expected, what happened, the device, and the time in your recording.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least 1 year of manual testing on web or mobile apps. SaaS is a plus; billing, invoicing or payment apps are a big plus.

- A working iPhone AND an Android phone of your own, plus a computer.

- Clear written English.

- You're comfortable recording your screen and talking through what you're doing. EVERY session is recorded, with your voice. This is required, and it's paid time.

- About 4 hours a day, Monday to Friday. Some overlap with US Pacific mornings (your late evening) is a plus.



PAY

- $550 a month base for about 20 hours a week.

- Plus a bonus for each confirmed bug that our own automated (AI) testing missed: $10 for a serious bug, $3 for a small one, up to $150 a month.

- Paid twice a month. It starts with a paid 2-hour trial on the real app.



HOW TO APPLY (applications missing any of these are skipped)

1. Put the word SANDPIPER in the first line of your application.

2. Tell us which iPhone model and which Android phone you own.

3. Include a link to a 1-2 minute screen recording (Loom or Google Drive) of you testing the sign-up page of any website, talking through what you check and what you would report.

We're not just looking for someone who can make websites look beautiful. We want someone who understands that great design should also help businesses attract, engage, and convert customers.

- Translate customer research, business objectives, and brand guidelines into effective website designs.

- Ensure websites look and function beautifully on desktop and mobile.

- Collaborate with our team, incorporate feedback, and proactively suggest improvements.

- Explore ways to use AI to automate repetitive tasks and improve the design/development process.

Must-haves:

- Excellent visual design skills, including layout, typography, spacing, color, and visual hierarchy.

- Strong written English and clear, proactive communication.

- Exceptional attention to detail.

- A desire to understand the business objectives behind a website, not just make it look attractive.

- Curiosity, initiative, and strong problem-solving skills.

- Enthusiasm for using AI tools to work more effectively.

- Dependability and an interest in building a long-term working relationship.



Nice-to-haves:

- Experience designing and developing real websites, particularly with WordPress and Elementor.

- Experience with Figma or similar design tools.

- Understanding of UX, conversion rate optimization, and website accessibility.

- Familiarity with SEO best practices.

- Experience using ChatGPT, Claude, Codex, or other AI tools for design and website development.



You don't need to be an expert at everything. We're more interested in someone with strong design instincts, good judgment, and a willingness to learn.



Why work with us?

- Variety: Work across different industries, businesses, and website types.

- Growth: Learn from an experienced digital strategist and former Director of Product Management.

- Flexibility: Work remotely with flexible hours.

- Innovation: Experiment with emerging AI tools and new ways to design and build websites.

- Long-term opportunity: We're looking for someone who can become a trusted member of our extended team, not just complete a few short-term projects.

- Meaningful impact: See how your design decisions help real businesses grow.



Compensation and schedule

- Target compensation: approximately $10 USD/hour.

- Part-time, flexible schedule with ongoing project opportunities.

- Hours will vary based on client needs.

- We're looking for a long-term working relationship.



How to apply



Please provide:

- Your portfolio: Links to 2–3 websites you've designed. Explain which parts of each project you personally completed.

- Your design philosophy: In a few sentences, what makes a business website effective beyond looking attractive?

title: Payment Poster (US Medical Billing, Eastern Hours)
description:
ABOUT US



WoundGen is a US mobile regenerative wound care company. We provide physician-led wound care to Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial patients in multiple states, including skilled nursing facilities, long-term care, assisted living, and home health. We are hiring a full-time independent contractor to post payments and adjustments accurately.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The Payment Poster posts insurance and patient payments, contractual adjustments, and denials to the correct accounts, then reconciles each deposit to the bank. You will work electronic remittances (ERA/835) and paper EOBs, research unapplied cash, and route denial information to the AR team. This is a remote independent contractor role, not employment. You will report to the Payment Posting Supervisor.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Post daily payments, adjustments, and denials from ERA/835 files, paper EOBs, EFTs, and other remittances to the correct accounts

- Apply contractual adjustments, copays, deductibles, and other payer adjustments per policy and the remittance

- Review EOBs and ERAs to confirm payment accuracy, and flag short-pays, overpayments, and recoupments

- Reconcile daily deposits and posting batches to bank or lockbox reports; resolve variances the same day when possible

- Research and clear unapplied or unidentified cash

- Code and route denials and underpayments to the AR team with clear notes

- Keep accurate audit trails and posting notes in company systems

- Keep each billing entity's deposits, bank accounts, and records strictly separate; never post one entity's payment to another

- Refunds, reversals, adjustments, and write-offs require company approval

- Follow HIPAA and company privacy rules at all times



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of US medical payment posting experience, including ERA/835 and paper EOB posting

- Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial remittances

- Working knowledge of EOB/ERA review, contractual adjustments, and CARC/RARC denial and adjustment codes

- Experience reconciling deposits to a bank or lockbox report

- Strong written and spoken English

- Stable internet and a quiet, private workspace

- Able to work full-time, Monday through Friday, during US Eastern business hours

- Able to follow HIPAA requirements and sign a Business Associate Agreement before system access

- No protected health information (PHI), credentials, or payer files on personal devices, personal
, local drives, or unapproved cloud storage. Work is done only in company systems over a company VPN or VDI.



PREFERRED



- Experience with Waystar or a similar clearinghouse

- Experience with Net Health or a similar EHR

- Wound care, home health, or skilled nursing billing experience

- Experience working a posting backlog and reducing unapplied cash

- Strong Excel or spreadsheet skills



SCHEDULE



Full-time, Monday through Friday, US Eastern business hours. This is a remote contractor role.



PAY



$800 to $1,200 USD per month, depending on experience. Paid as an independent contractor. No employment benefits.



HOW TO APPLY



Apply through this OnlineJobs.ph posting. To show you read this post, type the word RIVERBEND on the first line of your application, then answer both questions below. Applications that omit the word or the answers will not be reviewed.

- Keep claims and records for each billing entity strictly separate from any other entity

- Refunds, reversals, adjustments, and write-offs require company approval

- Follow HIPAA and company privacy rules at all times



REQUIREMENTS



- 2+ years of US medical billing or accounts receivable experience with denial management and appeals

- Experience with Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and commercial payers

title: Accounting Specialist (Remote, Part-Time to Full-Time, US Hours)
description:
About the Role

Are you a motivated, detail-oriented accounting professional who loves keeping numbers accurate and deadlines on track? We’re looking for an Accounting Specialist to manage the financial production for a portfolio of homeowners associations (HOAs) under a US-based community management company. This is a key operational role with hands-on exposure to bank reconciliations, AP/AR, and monthly financial reporting. If you’re organized, great at building working relationships, and looking for a long-term role where you can grow, this could be the right fit for you.



Key Responsibilities



Perform daily bank reconciliations

Support and manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes

Set up and update homeowner accounts and transfers

Respond to basic billing and account questions from homeowners

Help prepare and produce monthly financial reports, making sure they’re accurate and delivered on time

Communicate with community managers, vendors, homeowners, and others to clarify requests, gather documents, and resolve issues

Provide general accounting support and guidance to Community Managers

Organize and submit basic tax forms under supervision, and coordinate with tax and audit professionals when needed

Collaborate with team members and outside partners such as auditors and banking professionals on special projects

Meet deadlines for all managed associations based on contractual delivery dates

Maintain accounts receivable files and records



Qualifications



Basic understanding of accounting principles and solid technical accounting skills

Strong proficiency in Google Workspace

Experience with Vantaca is highly preferred

Excellent organization skills, a sharp eye for detail, and the ability to spot irregularities

Strong written and verbal communication skills

Quick to learn new software and systems

High sense of accountability, able to work independently, and willing to learn and grow

Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills



Preferred Qualifications



Currently enrolled in or completed a degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field

3+ years of experience in US accounting or bookkeeping

Data management skills



Why Join Us



Fully remote role with flexibility

Part-time with the opportunity to transition to full-time

Long-term position with a supportive team that values collaboration and professional growth

Hands-on experience in HOA accounting, working alongside experienced professionals



How to Apply



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and start your message with the phrase “You can count on me” so we know you read the full post. Applications without this phrase will not be entertained.

Who you are and your current or most recent role

Your experience with bank reconciliations, AP/AR, and monthly financial reporting for US clients

Why this role interests you



Please speak naturally and don’t read from a script. We want to hear how you communicate.

- Independent contractor, no employee benefits

- Starts at 4 hours a day and moves up to 8 quickly as you show accuracy

- $4.00 USD/hour for the first 90 days, then $6.00 USD/hour, with yearly performance raises. Not negotiable.

Send your resume and profile. Begin the first line of your message with "I read the full post," followed by the number of locations we have, your most recent typing test score, and your current work hours in EST (or "not employed"). Applications that don't follow this will not be reviewed.



Thanks, and good luck!

The role executes the content plan and repurposing strategy set by the Content Manager and serves as the Content Manager's production assistant.

In scope: all front-facing video (long-form YouTube, short-form Reels/Shorts/TikTok, ads, marketing, conference, course and product promos), podcast editing in long and short form, and all designed assets (lead magnets, workbooks, guides, slide decks, infographics, thumbnails, social graphics).



Essential Duties and Responsibilities

1. Video Editing — "R" for all front-facing video ([~40]% of time)

Edit long-form YouTube videos end to end: story structure, cuts, b-roll, captions, motion graphics, color correction, and audio cleanup.

Repurpose long-form content into short-form clips per the Content Manager's repurposing plan.

Produce ad creative in the formats, aspect ratios, and variations required for testing.

title: Head of Video Editing & AI Creative Production
description:
HIRING: Head of Video Editing & AI Creative Production



Monthly Salary: $8,000 USD + Performance-Based Bonuses

Job Type: Full-Time

Work Setup: Remote

Industry: E-commerce, Health & Wellness, Direct-Response Advertising



About the Role



We are looking for an exceptional Head of Video Editing & AI Creative Production to lead, train, and manage our growing team of video editors across multiple e-commerce health and wellness brands.



This is a senior leadership position—not just a video editing role. We need someone who combines advanced video editing skills, expertise in AI video generation, strong creative instincts, and proven team management experience.



You will oversee the production of high-performing direct-response video advertisements for platforms such as Meta, TikTok, and AppLovin. Our creative formats include traditional UGC, AI-generated UGC, AI animations, cinematic ads, AI drama ads, and other emerging advertising formats.



Your primary goal is to build and lead a high-performance creative production department that delivers exceptional video ads consistently, efficiently, and at scale.



Key Responsibilities



1. Team Leadership & Management



Lead and manage the daily operations of the video editing team.



Set production targets, monitor workloads, and ensure deadlines are met.



Review editor productivity, output quality, and overall performance.



Coach team members and develop improvement plans when needed.



Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and training new editors.



2. Creative Quality Control



Review video advertisements for hooks, pacing, storytelling, visual effects, sound design, and calls to action.



Ensure every ad meets creative briefs and direct-response advertising standards.



Provide clear, actionable feedback to improve creative quality and performance.



Establish quality assurance processes before final delivery.



3. AI Video Production & Innovation



Lead the use of AI video generation tools, particularly Higgsfield and similar platforms.



Oversee the creation of AI UGC, AI animations, AI drama ads, cinematic ads, AI voiceovers, and AI product videos.



Train editors on advanced AI workflows, character consistency, camera movements, lip-sync, and realistic storytelling.



Research and implement new AI tools to improve production quality and efficiency.



4. Training & Development



Develop onboarding programs, training materials, SOPs, and editing guidelines.



Conduct regular creative reviews and coaching sessions.



Build a library of winning ads, AI prompts, production templates, and best practices.



Help editors continuously improve their technical and creative skills.



5. Production Systems & Workflow Optimization



Build and improve the end-to-end video production workflow.



Track weekly output, turnaround times, revision rates, and deadlines.



Collaborate with creative strategists, media buyers, and operations managers.



Identify opportunities to automate repetitive production tasks.



Scale production volume without sacrificing quality.



6. Creative Performance & Optimization



Analyze successful advertisements to identify winning hooks, formats, and storytelling techniques.



Work with media buyers and creative strategists to translate performance insights into creative improvements.



Develop new production techniques and creative formats that support advertising performance.



Requirements



At least 5 years of professional video editing experience, preferably in e-commerce or direct-response advertising.



Proven experience leading, managing, or coaching a team of video editors.



Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, DaVinci Resolve, or comparable editing software.



Hands-on expertise in Higgsfield and modern AI video generation tools.



Demonstrated experience creating AI UGC, AI animations, AI drama ads, and cinematic AI content.



Strong understanding of Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, and conversion-focused creative.



Experience managing high-volume video production with multiple editors.



Excellent understanding of hooks, audience retention, pacing, storytelling, and calls to action.



Strong leadership, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.



Experience building production workflows, SOPs, and quality control systems.



Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with demanding production targets.



Preferred Qualifications



Experience working with eight-figure or nine-figure e-commerce brands.



Experience in supplements, health, wellness, or other competitive direct-response markets.



Experience scaling AI-powered creative production workflows.



Experience collaborating with creative strategists and performance media buyers.



A portfolio showcasing high-performing ads and advanced AI-generated videos.



Performance Expectations



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



Weekly video production output and team productivity.



On-time delivery and production efficiency.



Creative quality and execution of briefs.



Revision rates and quality assurance.



Quality and innovation of AI-generated content.



Team development and editor performance.



Contribution to winning advertising concepts and creative iteration.



First 90 Days



First 30 Days: Audit the editing department, assess team performance, review existing workflows, and establish quality assurance and performance tracking systems.



First 60 Days: Implement structured training, improve production efficiency, standardize AI workflows, and establish consistent production standards.



First 90 Days: Take full ownership of the department, reduce reliance on founder involvement, and build a high-performing team capable of consistently producing quality ads at scale.



Compensation & Growth



Base Salary: $8,000 USD per month



Performance-Based Bonuses: Additional compensation tied to production quality, efficiency, team performance, and measurable creative outcomes. Bonus targets and payout terms will be agreed upon separately.



This is an opportunity to take ownership of a growing creative production department and help shape the future of AI-powered advertising across multiple e-commerce brands.



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Portfolio: Provide links to your strongest direct-response video ads, preferably created for e-commerce brands.



2. AI Creative Samples: Share examples of AI UGC ads, AI animations, AI drama ads, cinematic AI videos, or similar projects you have personally created.



3. Leadership Experience: Describe the video editing teams you have managed, including team size, responsibilities, and leadership experience.



4. Production Capacity: Specify the number of high-quality video ads your team typically produces per week.



5. AI Workflow: Briefly explain your AI video production process, including the tools you use and how you maintain quality and consistency at scale.



6. Direct-Response Advertising Experience: How many years of experience do you have creating direct-response video ads? How familiar are you with hooks, audience pain points, benefits, CTAs, and conversion-focused storytelling? Briefly describe your experience.

Please apply only if you have the hands-on AI production expertise and leadership experience required for this position. Applications submitted through the link above will be reviewed by our team.

About Boost1 Enterprises



Boost1 Enterprises helps US clients fix their credit. We challenge inaccurate, unverifiable, or outdated items on credit reports, and we serve adults 18 and older in the United States. Our line is "Fix your credit. Unlock your lifestyle." Learn more at 
.



This is process-driven work. We do not promise specific results or score changes.

You will own our dispute and letter work. You review credit reports, identify items that qualify for dispute, draft FCRA-based letters, and send them once our founder approves them, following our SOPs. This is a remote role. It does not include sales, lead follow-up, billing, or intake calls, and it is not a general virtual assistant position.

.

.

: team chat and client files

- Most work is asynchronous in Credit Repair Cloud and 
. You need to be reachable and able to meet 30-day bureau deadlines.

- Some overlap with US Eastern time is a plus.



Pay



- $4 to $10 USD per hour, based on experience and accuracy, paid weekly.

- Performance bonuses for accuracy and on-time work, details shared at hire.

- Hours are tracked and logged daily, and every letter and action must be logged in Credit Repair Cloud the same day.

- Letters with errors or ineligible items must be redone.

- Pay is reviewed as volume grows.

How we work

- SSNs, dates of birth, account numbers, full reports, and logins stay inside Credit Repair Cloud and CreditHeroScore only. They are never pasted into 
, WhatsApp,
, chat apps, or other tools unless told to.

How to apply



Apply only through OnlineJobs.ph. Start your first message with BOOST1 so we know you read this post. Then include:



1. Your years of US credit repair or dispute experience.

2. Whether you've used Credit Repair Cloud, and for how long.

3. A 3 to 6 sentence answer: when would you dispute an item, and when would you leave it alone?

4. Optional: redacted sample letters only. Remove all client names, account numbers, Social Security numbers, and other private data.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
We’re looking for an Accounts Payable Specialist to support our construction client.



This isn’t a general AP role. We need someone who has actually done AP for construction clients and knows how messy it can get. Bills come in from a dozen subs on multiple different jobs, someone sends the same invoice twice, a vendor forgets their lien waiver. If that sounds familiar, keep reading.

- Entering vendor and subcontractor bills in QuickBooks Online, Buildertrend, and Ramp

- Coding each bill to the right job and cost code

- Checking bills against quotes and contracts, and catching duplicates or bills sent to the wrong project

- Keeping track of retainage, lien waivers, W-9s, and insurance certificates

- Putting together the list of what needs to be paid, then checking it against the bank and card activity

- Helping with month-end and monthly draws

- Working through a shared AP inbox and following up with vendors when something’s missing

- At least 3 years in AP, with 2 or more of those years working with construction companies

- You know your way around job costing, retainage, and lien waivers

- Good written English, since you’ll be
ing US vendors
