Desired Qualifications:

- Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.

- Strong billing knowledge, including reviewing account statements, payment histories, balances, and explaining charges clearly.

- Exceptional phone etiquette: Friendly, empathetic, patient, and able to de-escalate difficult conversations.

- Attention to detail: Ability to maintain accurate call logs, customer records, and documentation.

- Technical troubleshooting skills: Comfortable guiding customers through websites, online portals, and basic account access issues.

- Fast learner: Ability to quickly learn software, retain information, follow procedures, and independently research solutions.

- Previous experience in customer service, call center operations, or
 support.

- HOA, property management, real estate, or accounting support experience is a strong advantage.

- At least 6 months of remote work experience.

- Excellent organizational, multitasking, time management, and problem-solving skills.

- Reliable, accountable, resourceful, and able to work independently.



Software & Technical Skills:



Candidates should be comfortable navigating multiple applications simultaneously. Our Customer Care team uses:

- RingCentral: Inbound and outbound customer calls.

- Zendesk:
 support, ticket management, and customer follow-ups.

- CINC: Homeowner account management, billing, and portal assistance.

- Microsoft Teams: Internal communication and collaboration.

- Microsoft Office: Outlook, Excel, and other productivity applications.



Previous experience with these platforms is preferred but not required. Strong technical aptitude and willingness to learn are essential.



Remote Work Requirements:

- Must be available to work assigned U.S. time zone schedules.

- Comfortable using Hubstaff for attendance and productivity tracking.

- Personal computer or laptop no older than 2 years (no shared or family devices).

- Primary internet connection of at least 150 Mbps.

- Backup internet connection of at least 100 Mbps.

- Reliable alternative work location during power or internet outages.

- Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.

- Work schedules are assigned by management and may change based on operational needs.



Compensation, Benefits & Company Culture:



At The Nabo Group, we believe that happy, supported employees deliver exceptional customer care! We foster a positive, collaborative environment for all our team.



- Starting Rate: $6 USD per hour.

- Paid Time Off (PTO): Available after successful completion of the 90-day probationary period.

- HMO Allowance: Available after successful completion of the 90-day probationary period.

- Performance Incentives: Opportunities to earn rewards and recognition for outstanding customer service.

- Great Company Culture: A friendly, supportive team that values teamwork, kindness, and mutual respect.

- Training & Development: Ongoing coaching, learning opportunities, and professional growth.



How to Apply: Please complete ALL of the following steps to be considered:



1. Updated Resume: Attach your most recent resume in PDF format.

2. Rate Confirmation: Clearly confirm that you are comfortable with the starting rate of $6 USD per hour.

3. Video Introduction: Provide a shareable video recording introducing yourself and discussing:

- Your customer service and billing experience.

4.

title: Financial Operations & Executive Support Specialist
description:
Work Type: Remote 

Schedule: Full-Time Preferred  

Location: Philippines  

Salary: $1,200–$1,800 USD/month depending on experience



About the Role



StorHouse Management Co. is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Financial Operations & Executive Support Specialist to support our bookkeeping, financial reporting, client operations, and executive administration.



This is not a basic virtual assistant role.



We are looking for someone comfortable working in QuickBooks Online, who understands bookkeeping and reconciliations, can update cash flow reports and financial trackers, and can provide strong executive and administrative support.



You should be proactive, accurate, dependable, and comfortable working with confidential financial information.



Responsibilities



Bookkeeping & Financial Operations



- Perform bookkeeping for assigned client entities in QuickBooks Online

- Categorize transactions

- Reconcile bank and credit card accounts

- Review uncategorized and unusual transactions

- Maintain accurate general ledgers

- Assist with month-end bookkeeping close

- Update cash flow statements and cash flow forecasts

- Maintain financial dashboards and reporting spreadsheets

- Review accounts payable and accounts receivable

- Help keep client books current and organized

- Identify discrepancies or missing information and flag them for review



Invoicing & Accounts Receivable



- Prepare and send client invoices

- Maintain recurring billing schedules

- Track unpaid invoices

- Follow up on outstanding balances

- Maintain payment records

- Flag billing discrepancies



Master Sheets & Trackers



Maintain and update company-wide master spreadsheets, including:



- Master client and entity list

- Cash flow trackers

- Accounts payable tracker

- Accounts receivable tracker

- W-9 / 1099 tracker

- Deal and contract tracker

- Client onboarding and migration tracker

- Recurring deadline tracker

- Open items and follow-up tracker



Client & Entity Administration



- Maintain client and entity records in Canopy

- Organize and upload client documents

- Assist with client onboarding

- Help maintain client portals

- Track outstanding information and documents

- Help manage annual LLC and corporate registration deadlines

- Track POA and recurring compliance items

- Assist with monthly transcript-related workflows

- Follow up on missing W-9s and supporting documents



Ramp & Expense Management



- Categorize transactions in Ramp

- Match receipts to transactions

- Follow up on missing receipts

- Maintain missing-receipt lists

- Flag unusual or questionable transactions



Executive Assistant Support



- Maintain priority lists and follow-up items

- Assist with calendar and meeting coordination

- Prepare spreadsheets, reports, and meeting materials

- Draft routine client and vendor communications

- Follow up with clients, team members, vendors, and outside professionals

- Help ensure deadlines and outstanding items do not fall through the cracks

- Maintain organized electronic files

- Handle confidential information with discretion



Client Contracts



- Draft client service agreements using our existing templates

- Update agreements using the scope and pricing provided by management

- Confirm legal entity names, services, and fees

- Track contracts from draft through signature

- Save executed agreements in the correct client record

- Flag unusual contract terms for review



You will not independently set pricing, negotiate legal terms, or bind the company.



Required Skills



- Strong QuickBooks Online experience

- Hands-on bookkeeping experience

- Bank and credit card reconciliation experience

- Understanding of basic financial statements

- Strong Google Sheets or Excel skills

- Strong attention to detail

- Excellent organizational skills

- Strong written English

- Ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines, and projects

- Ability to work independently

- Strong follow-through

- Comfortable handling confidential financial information



Preferred Experience



Experience with any of the following is a plus:



- Canopy

- Ramp

- Gusto

- Rippling

- Google Workspace

- Accounting firms

- CFO or business management firms

- Executive assistant work

- Cash flow forecasting

- Client financial reporting



Who Will Do Well in This Role



You will be a strong fit if:



- You notice when numbers do not look right

- You enjoy keeping financial records organized

- You follow through without repeated reminders

- You are comfortable asking questions instead of guessing

- You can manage multiple responsibilities without losing track of details

- You enjoy both finance/accounting work and executive support

- You understand that a strong back office is essential to running a successful company



How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction

2. Your QuickBooks Online experience

3. Your bookkeeping experience

4. Your experience with bank reconciliations and financial reporting

5. Your experience with Google Sheets or Excel

6. Any experience with Canopy, Ramp, Gusto, or similar systems

7. Your current monthly salary expectation in USD

8. Your available work hours and time zone

9. Your internet speed

10. The word **STORHOUSE** at the top of your application so we know you read the full job post



Please also describe one example of a bookkeeping or financial issue you identified and how you handled it.

title: Podcast Producer
description:
**Podcast launch + weekly editing for a history video podcast**



I am launching *Aperitivo with Joseph* as host. It's a weekly video show on Italian history, sometimes with guests, sometimes just me, and it will run as a podcast on YouTube, Spotify and Apple. I record on Zoom. I need an intermediate but experienced podcast producer to set it up and then edit and publish each week.



**Setup (one-time, fixed price):**

- Set up Spotify for Creators and submit the RSS feed to Apple Podcasts, Amazon Music and YouTube

- Set up the YouTube channel or playlist (banner, description, playlists)

- Make the podcast cover art and a reusable thumbnail template in Canva

- Make or license a short intro/outro jingle and a sound "sting" for a recurring segment ("3 Things You Don't Know"). I must own the license.

- Set up my Zoom recording for podcast quality: separate audio file for each speaker, HD video, original sound, and a layout that shows my slides

- Write a simple step-by-step checklist of the publishing workflow



**Weekly (quote per episode):**

- Edit the full video and audio episode: clean-up, sound levels, intro/outro, slides

- Write show notes with chapters and my tour link, then publish on YouTube and the podcast apps

- Cut 4–5 short vertical clips plus one carousel graphic for Instagram and TikTok

- Be able to add in any ads or anything else when available



**Please send:**

- Links to podcasts you've launched or edited

- Your experience editing podcasts recorded on Zoom

- Your price for setup and your price per episode

- Which tools you use (for example Descript, Premiere, CapCut, Canva)    



Check out on Instagram Italian History with Joseph if you wish to understand the "vibe"

title: AI Video Creator for Meta Ads – Ecommerce Brand
description:
Do you create videos with AI tools like Google Flow, Nano Banana, ChatGPT or Seedance? We’re looking for you.



We’re an ecommerce brand selling to Spanish-speaking customers, doing $500K+ per month in revenue and spending €200K+ per month on Meta ads. All our ads are in Spanish. AI video ads are working really well for us right now: realistic scenes that look like live action, animations, characters, viral-style content. Ads that feel like content, not like ads.



We need someone who can create them and help us scale.



How it works:

We give you a reference video and the script. You turn it into a finished video with AI. You don’t need to speak Spanish: we send you the script with an English translation. But you need to be careful with Spanish text, captions and audio.



What you’ll do:



Create AI video ads from our scripts and references

Keep characters, locations and style consistent across every scene

Build and improve workflows so you can produce volume without losing quality

Iterate fast on winning videos based on performance data

Work directly with the founder and the creative strategist



What we’re looking for:



Real experience creating videos with AI

Strong skills with AI tools like Google Flow, Nano Banana, ChatGPT, Seedance, ElevenLabs, CapCut or similar

You can keep the same character consistent across every scene

You already have workflows to produce at volume

You stay up to date with new AI tools and trends

You’re smart and independent. You can follow processes, but you also find ways to improve them. You show up with solutions, not just problems

Good English for communication



What’s in it for you:



100% remote. Work from wherever you think best

Competitive monthly salary in USD + performance bonuses when your videos win

Full ownership of production. Nobody micromanaging how you do your work

Direct access to the founder. No pointless meetings

From brief to live test in less than 7 days. Your work doesn’t get stuck in endless revisions

See how a DTC brand really operates and scales: media buying, funnels, offers

Access to top creative and ecommerce courses paid by the company



We’re not looking for a contractor. We’re looking for someone who wants to be part of what we’re building.



How to apply:

About Us



Started in 2017 and we're growing like crazy.

Growing FAST - We sold 2663 lessons in 2026 and we're on pace to sell 3328 lessons in 2027.

We sell manual transmission driving lessons in the United States. Yes, really.

100% inbound leads from Organic Search (SEO). We don’t do cold calling.

Health Insurance

Paid Two weeks off for Christmas Season



Type of Employment

Full Time

40 hours per week





Entry Level Details

Note that this is an entry-level job. 

We do NOT expect you to have any prior sales experience. 

If you’re looking to switch careers and get your foot in the door, this could be great for you. 

We will train you on how to take customers through the sales process. 

This is a great opportunity for anyone with a background in any of the following areas: Customer Service, Nursing, Nurse Practitioners, Hotel and Hospitality, Front Desk, Secretary, Retail, Receptionist, Recruiting, Teachers and anyone with teaching experience, Tutoring, Inbound Representative, Inbound Sales, Outbound Caller, Appointment Setting, Cold and warm calling, Lead qualification





Duties and Responsibilities

Sell Stick Shift Driving Lessons

Inbound Call Handling - Answer phones and talk to prospects through the sale or sign up

Outbound Follow-Up - Call, text, and
 to get the prospect to the finish line

Qualify Prospects - Make sure their needs fit our model

Secret Message: When you apply, under the section that says "Is there anything else you'd like to write or include?", write the word PINK ELEPHANT. This will show us that you read the entire job description.

Outbound Dialing - Dialing prospective customers and leaving voi
s.

Text Message and
 Handling - Quickly handle inbound text messages and
s that are sent to the salesperson.

Paperwork Follow-Up - Follow up with prospective customers who have not yet signed up to make sure they got the paperwork. Handle any issues they had with doing the paperwork.

Review Solicitation - Follow up with customers after the lesson to request a review on Google and Yelp

Edit customer records in our CRM (HubSpot)





Qualifications

At least three years of work experience, preferably interacting with people. 

Must have your own computer, reliable high-speed internet, and good quality headset and microphone.

English Grammar and Language: You must be fluent in English

Strong Problem-Solving skills

Customer Service Oriented and ability to adapt/respond properly to different types of scenarios

Ability to Multitask, prioritize and manage time effectively





What's Hard About This Job

Working Remotely - We're a remote-first company, and we never want to have an office. This is great if you like working by yourself in the quiet, but it can be terribly painful if you need the energy of coworkers nearby.

Our Cultural Values - We're an American company with an incredibly unusual culture. Even by American standards, our 7 cultural values are highly unusual. Our culture is challenging for people accustomed to corporate culture and especially difficult for people who grew up in Confucian cultures. It's a great culture for people who speak directly and have a great deal of self-confidence and ownership. If you identify as a misfit, you'll do well.

Multiple Software Systems - You're going to need to learn how to use 12 different software systems. This is great if you want to get exposed to and experienced with lots of technology, but it can be tough if you have a hard time learning technology. Secret Message - When you apply, you'll see a box that asks if you want to add anything else. Type in PINK ELEPHANT in all capital letters exactly as we've shown it here. 





Cheat Code for getting a job with us:

1) Our application comprises the majority of our recruiting process. Because of that, we suggest that you give us thoughtful responses and rich stories. We typically only interview applicants who give rich and detailed answers to our questions. If you write short responses so that you can hurry up and finish the application, you will not get interviewed. 

2) Tell us stories about how your actions match your beliefs and values. For example, if I say I value health and fitness, you don't know if I'm telling you the truth or if I'm just telling you what sounds good. But, if I tell you things I've done, I can illustrate my values of health and fitness with proof. For example, I go to the gym 4 days per week, I've done 6 triathlons, including an Ironman, and I can swim 3000 meters in one hour. My examples of things I've done prove that my actions match my values system. 

3) Be vulnerable and honest. We take very detailed notes during the interview process, and we conduct extensive background checks. If the stories you tell about yourself don't match what your references say, we will not hire you. We'd rather hire a C student who is honest about being a C student than someone who is a C student but tries to pass themselves off as an A student. Remember, this is an entry-level job. We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for an excellent cultural fit.

SurviveX is looking for a results-driven B2B Sales & Business Development professional to help expand our presence in the US corporate market.



We manufacture first-aid kits and are developing a new sales channel focused on corporate gifting, promotional products, and branded merchandise.



You don't necessarily need previous experience in corporate gifting. What matters most is your proven ability to generate your own leads, engage business decision-makers, manage sales opportunities, and turn prospects into paying customers.



Experience in corporate gifting or promotional products is a strong advantage, but we are equally interested in successful B2B sales professionals from other industries who can bring transferable sales experience and a strong closing track record.



This is an ownership-driven, full-cycle sales position. You will be responsible for developing your own prospecting strategy, identifying potential buyers, conducting outreach, managing sales conversations, negotiating deals, and closing business.



You will help build a new US sales channel rather than simply follow an existing sales process.



********IMPORTANT******

This is NOT an appointment-setting, sales support, or order-processing role. We need someone who has personally generated business and closed deals.



***********************************

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



1. Business Development: Identify target markets, industries, potential buyers, and new B2B sales opportunities in the US.

2. Lead Generation: Research and build qualified prospect lists through LinkedIn,
, cold calling, referrals, and other outbound channels.

3. Cold Outreach & Sales Conversations: Initiate contact with US-based business owners, corporate buyers, procurement teams, marketing departments, and other decision-makers.

4. Needs Assessment: Understand customer requirements, purchasing budgets, order quantities, customization needs, and delivery timelines.

5. Full-Cycle Sales Management: Prepare proposals and quotations, present solutions, handle objections, negotiate terms, and personally close deals.

6. Account Development: Build long-term client relationships, develop repeat business, and identify opportunities to grow existing accounts.

7. Pipeline Management: Maintain accurate sales records, monitor follow-ups, track conversion rates, forecast opportunities, and report sales performance.

8. Channel Development: Help establish and improve SurviveX's approach to selling corporate gifting and promotional products in the US market.



***********************************

QUALIFICATIONS



**Required Experience and Skills**



- Proven experience in B2B sales, business development, or corporate account acquisition.

- Hands-on experience with cold calling, outbound prospecting, and lead generation.

- Demonstrated ability to personally negotiate and close sales.

- Experience managing the full sales cycle, from prospecting to closing and account development.

- Strong spoken and written English, with confidence communicating with US-based business decision-makers.

- Ability to work independently, take ownership of sales targets, and develop opportunities without constant supervision.

- Strong follow-up, negotiation, relationship-building, and pipeline management skills.



*****Nice to Have (Not Required)*****



- Experience in US corporate gifting, promotional products, branded merchandise, or corporate merchandise.

- Experience selling to US companies, distributors, HR departments, marketing teams, or procurement departments.

- Familiarity with corporate purchasing processes, bulk orders, and customized products.

- Experience using industry platforms such as SAGE, ESP, or commonSKU.



**We welcome experienced B2B sales professionals from other industries who can demonstrate a strong track record of personally generating and closing deals.**



***********************************

COMPENSATION & GROWTH OPPORTUNITY



- Base salary: US$1,500 per month + commission.

- Commission arrangements are negotiable based on experience.

- Opportunity to take ownership of a growing US sales channel.

- Direct contribution to the company's sales strategy, client acquisition, and revenue growth.



***********************************

HOW TO APPLY



Please submit the following:



1. Link to your CV/Resume: Include your relevant sales and business development experience.

2. Link to you Portfolio or Sales Track Record: Share examples of deals, accounts, or business opportunities you have personally generated and closed.

3. Link to your Sales Results Summary: Provide 2–3 bullet points highlighting your sales achievements. Include the industry, period covered, approximate deal values or results, and your individual contribution. Experience in corporate gifting is welcome, but B2B sales results from other industries are also accepted.

4. REQUIRED Recorded Video Introduction: Submit a 5–8 minute Loom video or similar recording covering:

- One real B2B deal you personally sourced and closed (any industry).

- How you identified prospects and generated leads.

- Your approach to cold calling and handling rejection or stalled opportunities.

- How you manage your sales pipeline and follow-ups.

- How you would approach your first 30 days with SurviveX building a new US corporate sales channel.



Please anonymize clients and protect confidential information. We are interested in your actual sales experience, ownership, and approach—not polished video production.



Also indicate your availability and ability to work with US business hours.



***********************************



If you can open doors, build business relationships, turn prospects into customers, and consistently close deals, we would like to hear from you!

title: Senior Airbnb Operations and Maintenence Manager/Supervisor
description:
Hello!



We’re seeking an experienced Senior Airbnb Operations Manager/Supervisor to run our short-term rental operation. In addition to handling the guests, the candidate should have a lot of experience managing maintenance and cleaning. The role starts part-time and may grow into full-time. This is NOT entry-level, and supervision experience is required.



We have five high-end rentals in North Carolina and California. Our guests expect exceptional service, fast communication and quick resolution.



You’ll manage the whole operation. That means finding and hiring good cleaners, handymen, HVAC professionals, plumbers, etc., supervising them, and understanding what’s actually wrong when a house has a problem: who to send, what it should cost, and whether the repair was done right. You own issues from start to finish without constant supervision, and you have a phone-always-on, ownership mentality.



Responsibilities



Find, vet, hire and manage cleaners (Turno), handymen and maintenance vendors, and check their work

Diagnose maintenance issues, get quotes, and follow up until fixed and verified

Spot problems early with preventive maintenance

Guest communication and reservations in Hostaway

Task tracking in Asana, team updates in Slack, and clear documentation

Airbnb Resolution Center cases, damage claims, escalations and review removals

Turning our Assistant Handbook into SOPs, and using AI to make operations run smoother



Requirements



Experience hiring and managing cleaners and maintenance vendors

Working knowledge of home maintenance and repairs

Management/supervision experience

Significant Airbnb operations experience, including Resolution Center cases, claims and escalations

Extensive Hostaway experience

Experience with Asana or similar

Excellent written English and communication

Experience and interest in AI

Evening and weekend availability

Airbnb Tier 2 / Senior Support / Trust & Safety experience strongly preferred



To Apply



Answer in your own words, without AI, with as much detail as you can. All answers will be analyzed for AI use.



1. Describe your short-term rental operations management/supervisor experience. Include your years in STR, how many of those you supervised others, and how many cleaners and vendors you managed.



2. Your level of experience with Hostaway.



3. What’s the most complex maintenance or cleaning problem you handled start to finish? What was wrong with the house, how you diagnosed it from afar, who you sent, what it cost, what went wrong along the way, and how it ended. Please use SPECIFIC examples 



4. How do you find and vet a good handyman or other service professional? Tell me about one who turned out to be bad and what you did.



5. Availability: for training, are you free mornings EST? For part-time, 4pm-7pm EST? For full-time, 3pm-12am EST? Do you understand this is part-time with potential to become full-time?

Please begin your application with:



“I am an experienced Airbnb operations manager with experience supervising others.”

Thank you!

title: Unity Developer I
description:
We’re looking for a Unity Developer to help build and maintain games and interactive experiences. You’ll work across the Unity stack with a primary focus on C# and systems code—gameplay logic, tools, integrations, performance, and pipelines. Genres and projects shift with what the team is building (RPG, tactical, casual, prototypes, and more); solid engineering matters more than specializing in one genre.



Schedule & flexibility



Core collaboration time: 9:00 AM PHT — standups, reviews, and live coordination usually happen in this window.

Flexible arrangement — we focus on outcomes and clear communication; outside that window, hours can flex to fit your workflow as long as deliverables and team sync stay on track.

Responsibilities



Game development — Implement and refine gameplay systems, mechanics, interactions, and editor workflows in Unity.

Scripting & programming — Write clean, maintainable C# for game logic, tools, AI, UI controllers, and third-party integrations.

Optimization & performance — Profile and improve CPU/GPU, memory, loading, physics, and rendering for target platforms.

Collaboration — Work with designers, artists, QA, and other engineers on features, pipelines, and iteration.

Debugging & quality — Find and fix bugs, improve stability, and tighten the player experience.

Requirements



Unity & C# — Hands-on Unity development with solid C#.

Systems & gameplay code — Comfortable with mechanics, UI wiring, data-driven design, and reusable architecture.

Problem-solving — Strong debugging, profiling, and performance troubleshooting.

Team collaboration — Experience in a multi-discipline game or interactive product team.

Version control — Comfortable with Git (or similar) and sensible branching/review habits.

Bonus skills



Multiplayer / networking (e.g. Netcode, Mirror, Photon, custom solutions).

AI, pathfinding, or behavior systems.

Procedural content, addressables/content pipeline, or build automation.

Shaders (Shader Graph / HLSL) or render pipeline work (Built-in, URP, HDRP).

Native plugins, platform SDKs, or console/mobile shipping experience.

Animation — Timeline, Animator state machines, blending, root motion, or wiring animation to gameplay code.

UI — uGUI / UI Toolkit, responsive layouts, HUD/menus, data binding, and performant in-game interfaces.



What we offer



Varied Unity work across whatever genres and projects the team is shipping, with a code-first focus and room to grow into architecture, tools, and specialized areas.

Flexible hours anchored on 9:00 AM PHT for team overlap.

A collaborative environment where engineering quality and player experience both matter.



If you enjoy solving technical problems in Unity and want room to work on different kinds of projects, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Finance & NetSuite Specialist – Full-Time Remote
description:
Finance & NetSuite Specialist – Full-Time Remote

Opportunities for professional growth and performance-based pay increases



We are hiring an experienced Finance & NetSuite Specialist to support a U.S.-based company in the health and wellness industry. We’re looking for someone with in-depth NetSuite knowledge, strong accounting and finance skills, and practical payroll experience.



You’ll play a hands-on role in implementing NetSuite, helping translate the company’s finance and payroll needs into clear system requirements and reliable workflows. You’ll also support day-to-day financial operations as the business transitions to the system.



This role requires someone who already knows NetSuite very well and has helped implement it before. You should be comfortable guiding a team through unfamiliar decisions, recommending practical solutions, and taking ownership of your work.



Key Responsibilities:



Work with company leadership and implementation partners to understand finance and payroll requirements and translate them into NetSuite workflows



Take ownership of assigned implementation tasks, including supporting system setup, data preparation, testing, and launch



Recommend practical approaches to NetSuite processes and explain options clearly to colleagues who are less familiar with the system



Clean, organize, and validate financial data for migration, ensuring records and opening balances reconcile



Test accounting workflows and reports, document issues, and follow through on resolutions



Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, journal entries, and general ledger maintenance



Complete bank, credit card, and balance sheet reconciliations; investigate and resolve discrepancies



Support month-end close and prepare financial reports and supporting schedules



Prepare or review payroll inputs, follow up on discrepancies, and reconcile payroll-related transactions to the general ledger



Create and maintain NetSuite saved searches, reports, and dashboards



Troubleshoot NetSuite transaction and workflow issues, coordinating with implementation partners when needed



Document procedures and help colleagues use NetSuite effectively



Provide clear progress updates, flag obstacles early, and keep implementation tasks moving



Protect confidential financial, company, and employee information



Required Qualifications:



At least three years of relevant accounting or finance operations experience, including reconciliations, journal entries, and month-end close



Advanced, hands-on NetSuite proficiency, with substantial experience using its core accounting and finance functions



Direct involvement in at least one NetSuite implementation or migration, with meaningful responsibility for requirements, system setup, data preparation, validation, testing, or launch support



Ability to explain your personal contribution to a previous NetSuite implementation and the problems you helped resolve



Ability to work independently in NetSuite, investigate transaction discrepancies, troubleshoot workflow issues, and produce accurate reports



Strong working knowledge of NetSuite saved searches, financial reporting, CSV imports, and dashboards



Strong understanding of accounts payable, accounts receivable, the general ledger, and financial statements



Practical payroll experience, including reviewing payroll information, resolving discrepancies, and reconciling payroll entries



Strong Excel skills, including lookups, pivot tables, and reconciling information across multiple files or reports



Excellent written and spoken English



Ability to explain financial and system issues clearly, recommend solutions, and communicate confidently with a U.S.-based team



Strong attention to detail, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through



Ability to manage recurring finance deadlines alongside implementation tasks



Reliable internet and a quiet, private workspace



Availability to work the full U.S. Eastern Time schedule listed below



Applicants must bring established NetSuite expertise and hands-on implementation experience. Experience limited to basic data entry or viewing reports is not sufficient for this role.



Preferred Qualifications:



Bachelor’s degree in accounting, finance, or a related field



Previous experience supporting U.S.-based businesses



Experience configuring NetSuite finance workflows and supporting user acceptance testing



Experience reconciling financial information between a previous accounting system and NetSuite



Familiarity with U.S. payroll processes and payroll platforms



Experience documenting financial procedures and training colleagues



Relevant accounting qualification or NetSuite certification



Work Setup:



Full-time, permanent remote position; Philippines-based candidates only



Monday–Friday, 9 a.m.–6 p.m. U.S. Eastern Time



Eight working hours per day, with one hour of breaks throughout the day; 40 working hours per week



Schedule follows U.S. Eastern Time, including daylight saving changes



Target start date within two weeks



All confidential financial and employee information must remain within approved company systems



Who We’re Looking For:



Someone who knows NetSuite well and brings equally strong finance skills. You understand how transactions flow through the accounts, can recognize when a balance is incorrect, and know how to investigate and resolve the issue.



You’ve helped a business implement NetSuite and can explain what worked, what needed attention, and how you contributed. You’re comfortable guiding colleagues, asking the right questions, and turning business needs into practical processes.



You take ownership, communicate early, and follow through without repeated reminders. We’re looking for a dependable professional who can become a trusted, long-term member of the team.



How to Apply:



Please send your résumé and a brief introduction answering the following:



How long have you used NetSuite, and which accounting and finance functions have you personally handled?



Describe a NetSuite implementation or migration you supported. What were you personally responsible for?



Share one implementation or NetSuite workflow issue you helped resolve and explain how you approached it.



What experience do you have with reconciliations, month-end close, financial reporting, and payroll?



Give an example of a NetSuite report, saved search, or import you created or managed.



What is your earliest available start date, and can you work the listed schedule?



Please ensure your résumé clearly shows your NetSuite implementation experience and the finance and payroll responsibilities you have personally handled.



SKILL REQUIREMENT



NetSuite | NetSuite Implementation | Accounting & Finance | Payroll | Microsoft Excel

title: Recruiter
description:
Our company is on a mission to redefine the way job seekers navigate their next career move. As a Reverse Recruiter, you will play a key role in this transformation, acting not just as a guide, but as a dedicated recruiter focused on helping our clients secure and land meaningful job opportunities.



In this role, you will partner closely with job seekers, taking the time to deeply understand their professional background, career goals, and personal preferences. You will then proactively identify, pursue, and match them with opportunities that align with their aspirations. Your work will directly impact their success by positioning them competitively in the job market and increasing their chances of getting hired.



Key Responsibilities:

• Build strong relationships with clients, serving as their recruiter, advisor, and advocate throughout their job search journey.

• Actively source and identify job opportunities that align with each client’s experience, skills, and career goals.

• Manage and maintain a consistent pipeline of relevant job postings tailored to each client.

• Evaluate job postings to ensure they meet client criteria and present strong placement potential.

• Support clients in the application process by guiding them on where and how to apply effectively.

• Serve as the main point of contact, providing ongoing support, updates, and strategic advice.

• Meet and exceed daily targets related to job sourcing and application activity.



Qualifications:

• Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred.

• Strong command of English, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple clients and priorities.

• Strong interpersonal skills with a genuine passion for helping others succeed.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and related tools.

• Proven ability to meet or exceed performance targets.

• At least 2 years of experience in recruiting or talent acquisition.



This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a results-driven environment and is passionate about helping people land jobs that align with their goals. As a Reverse Recruiter, your success is measured by your ability to connect clients with the right opportunities—and ultimately help them secure their next role.

This role is ideal for someone who understands that great social media content is about more than simply splicing a video. You should know how to capture attention, maintain viewer retention, create strong hooks, and package content in a way that makes people want to click and watch.



You’ll primarily work with video footage that we provide and turn it into engaging videos and short-form content for platforms such as YouTube Shorts, TikTok, Instagram Reels, and

Ideally, you also have experience creating long-form content for YouTube with supporting graphic design skills for thumbnails.







About AppAid



AppAid is a dedicated Social Security advocacy group committed to assisting individuals with disabilities who are unable to work full-time. Our mission is to guide and support clients through the Social Security Disability Insurance (SSDI) and Supplemental Security Income (SSI) application and claims process, ensuring they receive the benefits they deserve.



As our company continues to grow, we’re investing in our digital presence to expand our YouTube and social media channels and reach more people with helpful, engaging content about the disability benefits process. We’re looking for talented individuals to help us grow that audience and support our continued growth.





What You'll Do

Edit engaging YouTube videos and short-form social media content



Turn raw footage into compelling, polished videos designed to maximize viewer retention



Identify strong moments, hooks, and storylines within longer footage



Create engaging openings that capture attention within the first few seconds



Add captions, graphics, B-roll, sound effects, music, zooms, transitions, and other elements when appropriate



Create high-click-through-rate YouTube thumbnails



Develop multiple thumbnail or title concepts when appropriate



Repurpose longer videos into Shorts, TikToks, Reels, and other social content



Adapt editing styles and formats for different platforms



Help identify trends, formats, and content opportunities that could help grow the channel



Collaborate with our team on video concepts, hooks, titles, thumbnails, and overall content strategy



Stay up to date with YouTube and short-form video trends within the Social Security Disability niche





What We're Looking For/Required:

Strong video editing skills



Experience editing content specifically for YouTube/Shorts and/or social media



Strong understanding of pacing, storytelling, hooks, and viewer retention



Ability to create professional and attention-grabbing thumbnails



Strong visual and creative instincts



Ability to take raw footage and identify the most engaging moments



Ability to receive and implement feedback promptly, making requested revisions accurately and within a reasonable timeframe



Reliable communication and ability to meet deadlines



Strong attention to detail



Strongly Preferred:



Demonstrated experience using video editing and content strategy to grow a YouTube channel, including measurable improvements in views, watch time, subscribers, or engagement

Experience developing YouTube thumbnails



Experience with A/B testing or experimenting with different hooks, titles, thumbnails, or editing styles



Experience with Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, CapCut, Photoshop, or similar tools







The ideal candidate is creative, curious, and focused on results. They should be able to look at a piece of footage and think:



"What is going to make someone stop scrolling?"

"What will make them keep watching?"

"What's the strongest moment in this footage?"

"How can we package this so someone wants to click?"

title: Google Ads Manager, Professional Services Lead Generation (US Tax Advisory Firm)
description:
Job Title: Google Ads Manager, Professional Services Lead Generation (US Tax Advisory Firm)



Type: Part-time contractor, ongoing monthly retainer

Hours: 10-15 professional hours per month

Schedule: Flexible. Must be available for a 30-minute check-in call every two weeks during US Eastern business hours 11 am-2 pm ET / 11 pm-2 am PHT).

Compensation: . Negotiable for candidates who can demonstrate 5+ years of documented professional services PPC management with verifiable results.



---



The Firm



Simonsgroup Tax Advisory is a strategic tax planning firm in Washington, DC. Not tax preparation. Not seasonal filing. Our clients are business owners ($300K-$5M revenue), high-income tech professionals, and real estate investors. Engagement values range from $1,800 to $10,000+.



The Google Ads account runs Search campaigns in the DC, Maryland, and Northern Virginia metro area. Monthly ad spend: approximately $2,000. The only conversion that matters: intake form submissions that result in booked advisory consultations.



---



Why This Role Exists



The account has been through three vendor relationships in eight months. Each produced the same pattern: generic reporting without actual data, keyword strategies that attracted tax preparation shoppers instead of advisory clients, and tracking configurations that inflated conversion counts while real lead quality degraded.



Two independent audits have been completed. A separate Phase 1 engagement will fix the structural and tracking issues those audits identified (GA4 misconfiguration, conversion tag duplication, broken Enhanced Conversions, campaign restructuring, landing page alignment). Phase 1 must be complete before this engagement begins.



This role picks up after the foundation is repaired. Your job: keep the data clean, keep the budget protected from waste, and steadily improve cost per qualified lead.



---



Weekly: Search Term and Negative Keyword Management (4-5 hours/month)



The most important recurring task. Corporate tax keywords cost $10-$25 per click. Without weekly review, Google's algorithms will match your ads to consumer tax prep queries, IRS self-service searches, competitor name lookups, and job seekers within days. This has been documented and measured in this account.



Every week:



- Pull the search terms report for the prior 7 days

- Review every query that generated a click

- Add negative keywords for competitor names, consumer queries ("free tax services," "file my taxes"), IRS self-service queries ("irs payment plan," "form 9465"), job seeker queries ("bookkeeping jobs remote"), and out-of-market locations

- All negatives as phrase match. Not exact match. Exact match negatives let variants through. This has been a recurring vendor failure on this account.

- Maintain a running log: date, keyword, match type, rationale

- Flag any emerging search pattern that suggests a keyword or ad group adjustment



Weekly means weekly. A competitor name that collects 3 clicks before it is blocked costs $30-$75.



---



Bi-weekly: Performance Monitoring and Bid Management (2-3 hours/month)



- Flag any keyword with $75+ spend and zero conversions over a rolling 30-day window

- Monitor geographic performance. DC and Maryland convert. Virginia locations have historically shown near-zero activity. Diagnose and recommend if that pattern continues.

- Monitor device performance. Mobile has consistently outperformed desktop on conversion rate in this account.

- Verify ad scheduling restricts spend to business hours. No serving between 10pm and 6am.

- Review auction insights monthly. Track competitive position against 
, H&R Block, and Intuit.



---



Bi-weekly: Reporting (2-3 hours/month)



Written report every two weeks. Data, not descriptions. Every report includes:



- Spend by campaign and ad group

- Impressions, clicks, CTR, CPC, conversions, cost per conversion by ad group

- Search impression share: total, lost to budget, lost to rank

- Top-of-page rate and absolute top-of-page rate

- Quality scores for top 10 keywords by spend (including Landing Page Experience, Ad Relevance, Expected CTR sub-scores)

- Auction insights: top 5 competitors by impression share

- Top 15 search terms by spend with clicks, cost, conversions

- Negative keywords added during the period (from the running log)

- Location performance by targeted area

- Device performance breakdown

- Conversion action health: verify tag is firing, confirm primary/secondary configuration, reconcile Google Ads conversions against Tally form submission count

- Actions taken since last report (specific changes, not descriptions of process)

- Recommendations for next period with rationale



Reports that describe what a metric means without providing the actual number will not be accepted. Three consecutive vendors delivered reports with section headers and metric definitions but no data. That is the standard this role replaces.



---



Monthly: Ad Copy Testing (1-2 hours/month)



- Maintain at least 3 responsive search ad variations per ad group

- Test headlines reflecting advisory positioning: S-Corp strategy, entity structuring, high-income tax planning, real estate investor tax, IRS resolution

- Pause underperformers based on CTR and conversion rate. Not ad strength scores.

- Ensure ad copy aligns with landing page content



---



Ongoing: Conversion Tracking Integrity



Phase 1 fixes the tracking. This role keeps it clean.



- Test the intake form conversion tag quarterly (submit a test form, confirm it registers in Google Ads)

- Monitor for double-counting anomalies (any keyword with a conversion rate above 100% gets investigated immediately)

- Verify conversion values remain correctly assigned ($200-$500 per lead type)

- Reconcile Google Ads click count against GA4 paid sessions monthly

- Reconcile reported conversions against Tally submission count bi-weekly



The account has a documented history of tracking failures that corrupted Smart Bidding. Ongoing verification is not optional.



---



Required Experience



Minimum 5 years managing Google Ads Search campaigns for professional services firms: law firms, accounting firms, financial advisory, tax advisory, consulting, or medical practices. You must have managed at least 3 accounts in this category over that period.



General experience with e-commerce, local trades (plumbing, HVAC, landscaping), or app install campaigns does not substitute. The keyword economics, conversion paths, and lead quality standards for a $5,000 advisory engagement are fundamentally different from a $200 service call.



Additional requirements:



- Demonstrated experience with form-based or consultation-based conversion tracking, not e-commerce transactions

- Proficient with impression share analysis, quality score diagnostics, auction insights, and search term management at the query level

- Understands how conversion action configuration (primary vs. secondary, count setting, attribution window, value assignment) affects Smart Bidding behavior

- Can diagnose geographic targeting issues (e.g., algorithm deprioritizing specific locations due to budget constraints)

- Clear, data-driven written reporting in English

- Works in the client's own Google Ads account via MCC access



Preferred:



- Experience managing campaigns in the US professional services market

- Familiarity with Tally, Calendly, or similar form/scheduling-based conversion tracking

- Experience with Maximize Conversions and Target CPA bidding transitions

- Google Ads Search certification



---



Account Access



The Google Ads account is owned by Simonsgroup. You receive manager-level access via MCC. Account ownership does not transfer. All campaigns, keywords, ads, conversion tracking, and work product remain in the Simonsgroup account. If the engagement ends, the account continues with no disruption.



---



Timezone



The firm operates on US Eastern time. Bi-weekly check-in calls: 8am-12pm ET (8pm-12am PHT). Async communication via email for everything else. Responsiveness within 24 hours on business days is expected.



---



How to Apply



Answer all four questions. Applications that skip any question or send a generic cover letter will not be reviewed.



1. Name 2-3 professional services firms (law, accounting, financial advisory, medical) where you managed Google Ads on a monthly retainer for at least 6 months. For each: monthly ad spend, qualified leads per month, cost per qualified lead, and the single most impactful change you made. Anonymize client names if needed.



2. You pull this week's search terms report and see 8 of the top 20 queries by spend are people searching for specific CPA names ("john smith cpa," "abc tax services"). They generated $110 in clicks and zero conversions. What do you do, what match type for the negatives, and why that match type?



3. Google Ads shows 4 conversions this period. The intake form platform shows 7 submissions. What are the possible explanations and what would you check first?



4. Your monthly rate for this scope and hours.



Applications that answer all four questions with specifics will be prioritized. The next step is a short paid test task (compensated at your rate) before any ongoing engagement begins.

description:
SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER

Remote | Full-time |



*****ABOUT THE ROLE*****



ARE YOU THE SENIOR AMAZON MARKETPLACE GROWTH MANAGER WE’RE LOOKING FOR? 



Intent Brands operates SurviveX (first-aid and preparedness products) and Aerotrunk (luggage).

Website: 
/

: 



We are seeking an exceptional, numbers-driven Senior Amazon Marketplace Growth Manager to take

end-to-end commercial and operational ownership of our unified Amazon Seller Central account.



Currently generating approximately $20 million in trailing 12-month revenue, our portfolio consists of two

category-leading brands: one in First Aid & Emergency Preparedness and the other in Travel Accessories.

Both brands operate under a single Seller Central account, presenting significant opportunities for catalog

expansion, advertising efficiency, and cross-merchandising.



In this role, you are not simply managing listings. You are the primary owner of the channel’s P&L. You will

make high-stakes executive decisions backed by financial rigor, driving profitable top-line and bottom-line

expansion. You will orchestrate advertising strategy, listing conversion optimization, promotional calendars,

external traffic capture, and strategic relationships (including our Amazon SAS Core partner).



******** KEY RESPONSIBILITIES********



1. P&L Ownership & Financial Leadership

• Commercial Accountability: Own the Amazon channel P&L end-to-end, steering margin health,

revenue velocity, and net contribution.

• Cost & Margin Decomposition: Deeply analyze unit economics, Landed COGS, Amazon fee

structures (FBA fulfillment, referral, storage, aged inventory surcharges), and overall contribution margin

to inform pricing and operational decisions.

• Capital & TACoS Allocation: Determine and allocate target TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sales)

percentage points across specific product lines and ad formats to maintain healthy profitability while

unlocking incremental growth.



2. Advertising Strategy & External Traffic Leverage

• PPC Team Collaboration: Partner closely with our internal PPC Manager to execute high-performing

ad campaigns across all inventory formats:

• Sponsored Products (SP)

• Sponsored Brands (SB)

• Sponsored Brand Video (SBV)

• Sponsored Display (SD)

• TACoS Discipline: Ensure campaign efficiency aligns strictly with overarching P&L margin targets and

inventory lifecycle stages.

• External Traffic & Spillover Synergy: Quantify and leverage halo traffic originating from our

direct-to-consumer (Shopify) marketing channels. Devise strategies to capture, attribute, and accelerate

this external demand to boost Amazon organic rank and BSR velocity.



3. Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) & Listing Architecture

• Systematic CRO Audits: Regularly audit existing product detail pages (PDPs) across both brand

catalogs to identify friction points and conversion leakage.

• Hypothesis-Driven Testing: Develop structured CRO hypotheses for creative assets, infographics,

Premium A+ Content, copy, and video.

• Creative Collaboration: Partner with our Creative Designer to produce conversion-optimized creative

assets based on your strategic briefs.

• A/B Experimentation: Design, execute, and monitor iterative A/B tests (via Amazon Manage Your

Experiments and third-party tooling) to systematically identify winning listing iterations that maximize

conversion rate and session value.

• Search Query Performance (SQP) Optimization: Utilize Amazon SQP and Brand Analytics data to

reverse-engineer customer search intent, refining titles, bullet points, backend search terms, and

descriptions for organic dominance.



4. Merchandising, Cross-Selling & Promotional Strategy

• Parent/Child ASIN Architecture: Capitalize on our high-performing cross-selling parent ASIN

structures to maximize basket size, customer lifetime value, and cross-brand discovery.

• Deal Cadence & Execution: Plan, schedule, and execute high-impact promotional events, including

7-Day / Best Deals and Prime Exclusive Deals (PEDs).

• Deal Post-Mortems: Rigorously evaluate every promotional event to assess whether it delivered

genuine incremental velocity while safeguarding net contribution margins.

• Amazon Storefront Optimization: Continuously evaluate Storefront performance and landing page

entry points. Optimize brand narrative, user navigation, and the path to purchase to reduce bounce rates

and maximize average order value (AOV).



5. Technical Operations & Strategic Escalations

• Catalog Health & Compliance: Work in tandem with our Amazon Technical Specialist to proactively

maintain account health, resolve listing suppressions, remediate stranded inventory, and expedite case

resolution.

• Amazon SAS Core Management: Serve as the primary operational and strategic liaison with our

dedicated Amazon SAS Core representative, leveraging this relationship for new beta programs,

commercial growth opportunities, and critical issue escalations.





********CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS********



**Required Experience:**



1.) High-Volume Track Record: 5+ years of hands-on Amazon Seller Central management, with proven

success steering high-volume, 8-figure accounts ($10M to $20M+ annual run rate).



2.) P&L Fluency: Thorough understanding of e-commerce financial models, contribution margin analysis,

fee structures, and TACoS/ROAS balance.



3.) Advanced Amazon Tooling: Mastery of Amazon Brand Analytics, Search Query Performance (SQP),

Manage Your Experiments, Category Insight reports, and the full Amazon Ads console.



4.) Analytical & Data-Driven: Exceptional analytical capability with advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills;

ability to turn granular marketplace data into decisive commercial action.



5.) Strategic CRO Expertise: Demonstrated experience developing creative briefs, formulating conversion

hypotheses, and executing split-testing protocols.



6.) Autonomous Leadership: Executive presence and proactive mindset capable of managing

cross-functional contributors (PPC specialists, technical support, creative designers).



**Preferred Qualifications**

1.) Direct experience in consumer physical products within the Emergency Preparedness / First Aid or

Travel Gear / Accessories categories.

2.) Familiarity with omni-channel dynamics, specifically the interaction between Shopify D2C advertising

and Amazon organic lift.

3.) Experience managing Amazon SAS Core or equivalent dedicated account management programs.



********HOW TO APPLY********

To apply, please submit:



1.) Links to your Updated Resume & Portfolio

2.) A brief Cover Note or Loom Video addressing:

- The annual revenue scale of the largest Amazon Seller Central account you have personally managed.

- How you approach calculating and managing TACoS allocation across Sponsored Products, Sponsored

Brands, and Sponsored Display within a strict P&L framework.

- One specific example of a successful listing CRO experiment or promotional strategy you designed and

scaled on Amazon.



******COMPENSATION & BENEFITS******



• Base Salary: $3,500 to $5,000 USD per month, commensurate with experience and past scale

managed.

• Performance Bonus: Aggressive annual cash bonus tied directly to hitting clear, pre-agreed P&L and

growth KPIs.

• Work Arrangement: 100% Remote / Distributed team.

• Impact & Ownership: High degree of executive autonomy over a substantial, mature $20M business

line with direct exposure to brand leadership.



WE CAN’T WAIT TO REVIEW YOUR APPLICATION AND DISCUSS HOW WE CAN SUPPORT YOUR STRATEGIC VISION! 🏆🔥

title: Virtual CIO (vCIO) – Strategic IT Consultant
description:
We are seeking a strategic and business-minded Virtual CIO (vCIO) to serve as a high-level advisor for our diverse portfolio of business clients. In this role, you will act as an extension of our clients' executive teams, bridging the gap between their business goals and their technology infrastructure.



As a vCIO, you are not just a technical expert; you are a strategic partner. You will be responsible for developing long-term IT roadmaps, managing technology budgets, overseeing risk and compliance, and ensuring that every technical investment our clients make drives measurable business value. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of Managed Services (MSP), excellent consultative skills, and the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business strategies.



Key Responsibilities

*Strategic IT Roadmapping & Planning

- Conduct regular Strategic Business Reviews (SBRs) with clients to align technology with their 1–3 year business goals.

- Develop and maintain comprehensive IT roadmaps, including hardware lifecycle management, cloud migrations, and

security enhancements.

- Identify emerging technologies that can provide a competitive advantage or operational efficiency for specific client

verticals.

*Budgeting & Financial Management

- Assist clients in developing and managing annual IT budgets.

- Provide Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analysis for new technology investments.

- Help clients prioritize IT spending based on risk, ROI, and business impact.

*Risk, Security & Compliance

- Oversee client security postures, ensuring alignment with frameworks like NIST, CIS, or industry-specific regulations

(HIPAA, PCI, SOC2).

- Lead Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BC) planning and testing.

- Act as a high-level advisor during security i
 or complex technical audits.

*Client Relationship & Account Leadership

- Serve as the primary point of contact for executive-level stakeholders (CEOs, CFOs, Owners).

- Monitor client satisfaction and service delivery trends, working with the technical team to ensure high standards are met.

- Lead the technical onboarding of new high-value clients, setting the strategic foundation from day one.

*Vendor & Project Oversight

- Assist clients in evaluating and managing third-party technology vendors (ISPs, Line-of-Business software, etc.).

- Provide high-level oversight for major infrastructure projects to ensure they stay aligned with the strategic vision.



Qualifications

Required

- Experience: 7–10+ years of experience in IT leadership, senior systems engineering, or IT consulting (MSP experience is highly preferred).

- Strategic Mindset: Proven ability to develop long-term technology strategies that solve real-world business problems.

- Financial Literacy: Comfort managing budgets, performing ROI calculations, and discussing financial impact with executives.

- Communication Excellence: Exceptional ability to present to "C-Suite" executives and translate "geek-speak" into "business-speak."

- Broad Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of Microsoft 365, Cloud Infrastructure (Azure/AWS), Networking, and Cybersecurity frameworks.

- Consultative Approach: Strong ability to influence stakeholders and lead through consensus and expertise.



Preferred (Nice to Have)

- Experience with ITIL frameworks or MSP-specific vCIO tools.

- Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, PMP, or advanced Microsoft/Cloud certifications).

- Previous experience in a "Fractional CIO" or "Account Lead" role within a technical service organization.



What Success Looks Like in This Role

- Clients view you as an indispensable member of their leadership team, not just a "vendor."

- Client IT environments are stable, secure, and proactively managed according to a documented roadmap.

- Technology spend is predictable for the client, with fewer "emergency" expenses.

- High client retention and growth through trusted, strategic recommendations.



Why Join Us?



We believe in creating an environment where our team members can thrive both professionally and personally. Here’s what we offer:



*Career Growth: Paid certifications, training, and structured onboarding to help you advance your skills.

*Attractive Compensation: Competitive salary, performance-based incentives (monthly profit share and end-of-year bonus), and 13th-month pay.

*Health & Wellness: Monthly healthcare allowance to support your well-being.

*Work-Life Balance: 100% remote work with company-provided equipment.

*Supportive Culture: Be part of a forward-thinking team that values collaboration, innovation, and having fun while doing great work.



What Sets Us Apart?



*Performance-Based Rewards: Monthly profit sharing and bonuses for high-performing team members.

*Continuous Learning: We invest in your growth with paid certifications and training.

*Collaborative Environment: Work with a team that values your input and supports your success.

*Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work while contributing to impactful projects.



How to Apply

If you’re ready to take your IT career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you! Apply now and join a team that’s passionate about technology, growth, and delivering exceptional service.



*Submit your application and include the numbers (3000) in your subject line. This helps us ensure you’ve read the full job description.

This is an overnight position. The working hours for this role are 8AM-5PM CST Monday to Friday.

- All video scripts – no scriptwriting required.

- Clear instructions and video examples.

- A simple and repeatable content format.

- Consistent work for the right person.

- Opportunities to increase your earnings by producing more videos.



## Payment



Payment per completed video or per batch of videos, depending on your experience and production capacity.



We are looking for a long-term collaboration with someone who can produce videos efficiently while maintaining consistent quality.



## How to apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. A short introduction about yourself.

2. A 20–30 second video of yourself speaking English so we can evaluate your accent and delivery. You can wear a mask or cover your face if you prefer.

3. Examples of previous videos you have created (if available).

5. How many videos you could comfortably produce per day.

6. What camera or smartphone you use.

title: Chief Operating Officer/Client Success Manager
description:
# Chief Operating Officer — Online Business



**Company:** Resell Signals / SellPilot

**Position:** Full-Time

**Location:** Remote

**Compensation:** Base salary plus performance incentives. $50k to $120k OTE



## About the Position



We are hiring an experienced, hands-on Chief Operating Officer to take ownership of the daily operations of our growing e-commerce education and software company.



**This is not a beginner position.**



Our company is already generating more than **$1 million per year**, and we need someone who has previously managed the operations, fulfillment, client success, and staff of an established online business.



We are not looking for someone who wants to learn how to operate a company. We need someone who has already done it successfully and can step in, identify problems, manage the team, improve systems, and help us scale.



You will be responsible for making sure the company runs properly every day, clients are supported and getting results, staff members are performing, and fulfillment is being completed at a high standard.



## Key Responsibilities



### Operations and Fulfillment



* Take ownership of all daily company operations.

* Oversee client fulfillment, customer support, client success, and service delivery.

* Make sure every client receives what they were promised.

* Monitor client satisfaction, results, retention, refunds, cancellations, and chargebacks.

* Identify operational problems and resolve them without waiting for the founder.

* Create and improve SOPs, workflows, quality-control processes, and reporting systems.

* Ensure the business can operate smoothly without constant founder involvement.

* Provide weekly reports covering client results, team performance, problems, and priorities.



### Team Management and Hiring



* Manage fulfillment, support, client success, and operational staff.

* Set clear expectations, deadlines, responsibilities, and performance metrics.

* Hold staff accountable and address underperformance quickly.

* Recruit, interview, hire, onboard, and train new tea
mbers.

* Build strong department leaders who can manage their responsibilities independently.

* Ensure communication between sales, fulfillment, support, and marketing remains organized.



### Client Success



* Improve client onboarding, communication, support, and overall experience.

* Make sure clients are progressing and receiving measurable value.

* Identify inactive, confused, unhappy, or at-risk clients before they cancel.

* Resolve serious client problems professionally and quickly.

* Create systems that improve client results, retention, and satisfaction.

* Collect feedback, testimonials, case studies, and success stories.

* Make sure the sales team does not promise anything the fulfillment team cannot deliver.



### Systems and Growth



* Improve the company’s programs, software, services, and internal processes.

* Turn the founder’s ideas into organized projects, deadlines, and completed outcomes.

* Find opportunities to automate, delegate, or simplify repetitive work.

* Manage GoHighLevel, CRM automations, project management tools, and reporting dashboards.

* Identify new services, upsells, recurring revenue opportunities, and offer improvements.

* Monitor staffing requirements, fulfillment capacity, operational expenses, and profit margins.

* Prepare the company to handle more clients without lowering service quality.



### Content and Marketing



* Record one long-form YouTube video each week.

* Record short-form videos for Instagram and other social media platforms.

* Work with the marketing team on content, messaging, promotions, and campaigns.

* Help improve the company’s social media presence and positioning.

* Represent the company professionally and confidently on camera.



## Required Experience



Applicants should have proven experience:



* Managing operations for an established e-commerce, SaaS, coaching, education, or online service business.

* Overseeing client success, customer support, and fulfillment departments.

* Managing remote employees, contractors, and department leaders.

* Hiring, training, evaluating, and replacing staff when necessary.

* Creating SOPs, dashboards, quality-control systems, and performance scorecards.

* Managing a business with meaningful revenue, client volume, and operational complexity.

* Improving client retention, fulfillment performance, and team accountability.

* Making important decisions without constant founder approval.



## Preferred Experience



* E-commerce or online business operations

* High-ticket programs, coaching, digital education, or SaaS

* GoHighLevel and CRM automation

* Social media marketing and online advertising

* Sales funnels and digital products

* Client success and retention management

* Content creation and on-camera communication



## Who This Position Is Not For



This position is not suitable for someone who:



* Has only managed a small team or early-stage project.

* Is looking for their first operations leadership position.

* Requires constant instructions or supervision.

* Avoids difficult conversations with employees or clients.

* Has never managed fulfillment or client success.

* Only has theoretical knowledge of online business.

* Is uncomfortable being held accountable for company-wide results.



## What Success Looks Like



Within the first 90 days, you should be able to:



* Fully understand the company’s departments, offers, and fulfillment systems.

* Take daily operational responsibilities away from the founder.

* Establish clear performance metrics for every department.

* Improve client onboarding, support, results, and retention.

* Strengthen team accountability and communication.

* Identify staffing gaps and recruit stronger tea
mbers.

* Improve SOPs, reporting, automation, and quality control.

* Present a clear plan for scaling the company beyond its current revenue level.



## How to Apply



We are every single applications but Please submit:



* Your resume and a short introduction.

* The names and types of online businesses you have helped operate.

* The highest annual revenue level of a business whose operations you managed.

* The number of employees or contractors you directly managed.

* Your experience overseeing fulfillment and client success.

* Your experience using GoHighLevel or similar CRM platforms.

* A short video explaining why you are qualified for this position. If no intro video, your application will be ignored

* Your desired compensation and availability.



Include the phrase and password **“I will scale your company”** in your application so we know you reviewed the full posting.
